ios:6834918753.name: Oil Game Story
ios:6834918753.description:
It is 1900. You have twenty-five thousand dollars, a hunch and a hat.

Every sensible man in town says there is nothing under that hill. Lease it anyway. Sink the hole. And when she comes in, do it again, for a hundred and thirty years.

OIL GAME STORY is a calm, deep game about getting rich in the oil business: the land, the wells, the cheques, and the long patience in between.

THE DECISIONS ARE YOURS
• Read the map and take the lease before the big companies do.
• Sign the paperwork for every well. Keep it all, or lay the risk off on partners.
• At casing point the rig wires you what the hole shows: run pipe, or plug her and keep the money.
• Drill it up, flood it, sell it, or sit on it and wait for the price.

THEN THE MONEY COMES IN
• A cheque on the first of every month, and a counter at the top that never stops turning.
• A file for every well: what it cost, what it made, whether it ever paid out.
• Barn burners, dusters and dogs. You will have all three.

A CENTURY OF BOOMS AND BUSTS
• Real prices, real history: the gusher age, the boomtowns, a dime a barrel in the Depression, the embargo, the long bust, the shale revolution.
• Thirteen eras, from cable-tool rigs to three-mile laterals.
• Leases on the Arctic coast that nobody wants, and no pipeline for nine years. Seventy-million-dollar wildcats in the deep water of the Gulf. Countries abroad that keep their share and sometimes change their minds.
• And after 2030 the game does not stop. There is always another frontier, and the next one is further out than you think.

A COMPANY WITH A PAYROLL
• Landmen, geologists, tool pushers, bookkeepers: each with a face, a knack and an opinion, and now and then the nerve to voice it.
• Two dozen rival companies with silly names, every one of them after your acreage.
• Thirty-two painted newsreels for the big moments. None is ever forced on you.

A GAME TO LEAVE RUNNING
• Made to sit beside your work: the wells pump, the rig turns, and you look up when one comes in.
• Stops the clock for the big news, or never, as you like.
• Plays on iPhone and iPad, either way up.

ONE PRICE. THAT IS ALL.
No ads. No timers. No gems. No account. No internet needed, and nothing collected: the game makes no network calls at all. The only thing it wants you to buy is more acreage.

The companies in the game are inventions, and any likeness to a real one is parody. The voices are AI-generated.

ios:6829364719.name: Orbit Duel - DareDoesGames
ios:6829364719.description:
AIM AROUND THE PLANETS.
No ads. No energy meter. No account. No analytics. No internet. Just gravity.

FEATURES
- Every planet pulls your shot. Curve it, slingshot it, sometimes it comes back.
- Two to eight players: pass one phone, add computer players on Easy, Medium or Hard, or play one phone each nearby with no internet.
- One to five lives each. Each hit costs a life; the last ship flying wins.
- Play 1, 3, 5 or 10 rounds, or keep going.
- Watch shots at 1x, 3x or 5x, or hold the screen to fast forward. Every collision slows down and zooms in.
- Pause any time, on any phone.
- Build your own ship: eight hulls, sixteen paints, four shots and six trails.
- Aim with a joystick wherever your finger lands, then fine-tune.
- Your last shot stays on the field, faint, so you can adjust.

ios:6817346303.name: Pigeon’s Mission
ios:6817346303.description:
SAVE MOM & DAD!

One night, a little pigeon named Archie fell asleep. When he woke up, his whole family was gone, snatched by Crazy Guy, a goo-mutated villain with very big plans. Archie can't fly, but he's going anyway.

Pigeon's Mission is a pixel-packed platformer bursting with heart, humor and a whole lot of jumping. Wall-jump, dash and battle your way across seven dreamy worlds, outsmart bosses with backstories, and bring Archie's family home.


IT STARTED WITH A SKETCHBOOK
Logan was six when he walked up to his dad with an idea: he wanted to make his own video game. His dad JUMPED at it. Logan ran to his sketchbook and drew everything: the hero, the enemies, the worlds and the final villain. A small team signed on, and those pencil drawings became the game you're holding. Every character you'll meet started on one of Logan's pages.


TIGHT, SNAPPY, MADE FOR YOUR THUMBS
Wall-slides, midair dashes and combo attacks, with on-screen controls tuned so Archie moves the instant you do. Easy to pick up. Hard to put down.

EVERY SEED IS A CHOICE
Meet the Harvest Pulse System. Golden Seeds power every gadget you carry. Collect them from enemies and hidden corners, then decide: glide over the gap, blast the snail, or save up for something bigger?

SEVEN WHIMSICAL WORLDS
• Hill Hopping: your cozy intro to the adventure
• Dusty Dunes: enemy waves and desert wind puzzles
• Rocky Road: heavy combat and hidden smash paths
• Splashy Streams: underwater puzzles and glowing ruins
• Whacky Woods: carnival chaos meets high-speed coasters
• Heavenly Hike: skyborn combat and floating islands
• Cosmic Craft: the final showdown in a high-tech alien lair

SEVEN QUIRKY GADGETS
Glide with the Winged Wonder. Blast with the Pinecone Launcher. Suck up trouble with the DustBuster. Smash with the Rocky Hammer. Dive with the Hydro Helm. Rise with the Phoenix Feather. Then climb into the Tech Mech power suit for the grand finale.

MEET THE CREW
Archie Airborne: the hero. Can't fly.
Big Bob: the muscle. Also the snacks.
Meg: the heart. And the brains.

BOSSES WITH BIG PERSONALITIES
Big Bug digs, rolls and drops from above. Rocky Ronster throws fire punches over rising lava. The Magnificent Marvo, a magic squirrel, fights with illusions. Then come Ray the Rat, Whirlpool Wave, Flam, Crazy Guy himself, and one more we're keeping secret.


WHY FAMILIES LOVE IT
• Fun for kids, rewarding for seasoned platformer fans
• 4 to 6 hours of story
• No ads. No accounts. No in-app purchases. Ever.
• Plays offline, perfect for road trips and flights
• A real story about a real kid who dreamed big

BACKED AND FEATURED
• Kickstarter Project We Love, funded by 258 backers
• Featured by GameMaker
• Game Devs of Color Expo selection
• OTK Games Expo 2025 Chat Choice Award

Ready? Archie's family is waiting. Let's go!

PigeonsMission.com
A Glowing Cheetah Studios game, Miami, FL.

ios:6828354110.name: Pudding Racers
ios:6828354110.description:
Welcome to a kart world made of sugar! In Pudding Racers you zoom through Pudding Park, Lollipop Lagoon, Cotton Candy Fair, Gingerbread Town and the Ice Cream Alps – with drifts, speed and plenty of sugar. And everyone races together: iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV in the same race.

EVERYONE RACES TOGETHER
• Crossplay: iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV share the same race
• Up to 8 players on the same Wi-Fi network or via Personal Hotspot – no internet needed, just a short room code
• Online races against other players over the internet – with friends, you race together on Wi-Fi with a room code
• Bots fill the grid up to 12 racers, and there’s a Tournament mode too
• Emotes that everyone in the race can see

DRIVE WITH FEEL
• Drift for a Sugar Boost: hold your drift through Pinch and Spoon all the way to Bag, then let go and zoom!
• Bubblegum Start: hit the gas to the beat on 3, 2 and 1 and launch with a Sugar Boost.
• Cotton Candy Draft: stay close behind another kart and get pulled along.
• Stunts: spin in mid-air and land clean for an extra boost.

THE SUGAR JAR
No random item boxes here: your Sugar Jar fills up when you drive well – with Sugar Pearls, drifts, stunts and overtakes. Before the race you pick one of five recipes, from Soda Fountain to Pop Bonbon, and fire it at just the right moment. Everyone fills their jar at the same speed, no matter their position.

SINGLE PLAYER
• Race up to 11 bots across six difficulty levels, from Cozy to Extra Sour
• Treat Tour: several races in a row, with a Cake Podium and a Prize Lollipop
• Time Chase: race your own Glass Ghost and beat the Royal Baker’s time – with a Game Center world leaderboard for the fastest lap on each track
• Three Daily Tasks that change every day, three cherries on every track and 12 badges – which you also collect as Game Center achievements

GARAGE AND RACER
• Build your kart from body, tires, spoiler and engine – the parts change how it handles
• Paint jobs, stickers, antennas, turbo flames and horns for your style
• Five racers, including a gummy bear, a marshmallow bunny and an ice cream penguin – plus hats, glasses, scarves, colors and emotes
• Earn Bonbon Bucks in every race. Racers and accessories are purely cosmetic – on the track, only skill counts.
• Bucks packs are also available as optional In-App Purchases.

ONE PURCHASE FOR ALL YOUR DEVICES
Buy once, race everywhere: Pudding Racers runs on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. iCloud brings your progress to every device signed in with the same Apple Account – Bucks, unlocked items, records and badges included. You can turn this off in OPTIONS.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Customizable touch controls and game controllers, plus keyboard on iPad
• On Apple TV you need a game controller (tvOS 27 or later)
• Playable offline: single player and Wi-Fi races need no internet
• No ads, no tracking

ios:6834944096.name: Puffy Garage Spatial
ios:6834944096.description:

ios:6832545265.name: Puzzled Puzzler
ios:6832545265.description:
A frame drops. It lands, and smoke rolls around the whole frame. For ten seconds the whole picture is yours to remember. Then it comes apart.

Pieces fall at a steady pace. Slide a piece sideways, turn it, or flip it, and it keeps coming down. You cannot park it in the air. When it reaches the floor, the next piece waits five seconds, then falls. Next shows that piece and counts the wait. A faint ghost marks the landing. A light tune plays until you turn it off in Settings. Sound effects are separate.

Rotate it a quarter turn. Flip it across, or flip it down. The picture is not the same in a mirror, so the facing has to agree, not only the outline. Drop it on the matching part of the picture, or nudge a landed piece and tap Place. The right square and the right facing lock with a click. A wrong one stays in your hands.

A piece that has landed stays where you leave it. Move them apart. If four unplaced pieces overlap in one pile, that picture is lost. The piece still falling does not count, and neither does a piece you have already locked. When the last piece has fallen, a 60-second finish clock starts. When it runs out, you win the picture if two or fewer pieces are still out of place or loose; otherwise Start Level Over tries it again.

Twenty levels, each with more pieces than the one before.

Twenty pictures. The first ten are a meadow, a harbor, an orchard, a canyon, a night market, a glacier, an observatory, a reef, a train, and a rose window. The next ten are a kite hill, a bakery, a pond, a clock tower, a fair, a snow village, a library, a pumpkin patch, a ferry, and a firework garden. Each frame asks for more than the one before it. The last three keep 52 pieces and grow the board. Early frames trace the sockets. Later ones leave you with the memory of the ten seconds.

Puzzled Puzzler stays on this device. No account, no network, no ads, no purchases.

🎄 How to play
Each scene shows the objects you need to find. Pinch to zoom, drag across the picture, and tap what you spot. Some items sit in plain sight. Others blend into the lights, gifts, and furniture, so the fun is in looking twice. If you get stuck, use a hint and keep going.

A round is simple. Open a Christmas picture, check the list, and search until every object is found. Larger items help you settle in. Smaller ones ask for a closer look. When the list is clear, move on to the next scene. Nothing is counting down while you search.

🎅 Christmas scenes to explore
Move through snowy villages, Christmas workshops, gift-filled rooms, glowing streets, and warm living rooms. You will see sparkling trees, snowy rooftops, festive windows, and rooms full of holiday color.

The pictures are not copies of one living room. A quiet cabin, a busy workshop, a decorated dining room, and a street lined with lights each hide objects in different places. The clutter, the colors, and the corners worth checking all change.

🎁 What you will find
Look for the details that make a scene feel like Christmas: ornaments, wrapped presents, candy canes, stockings, bells, wreaths, gingerbread, and snowflakes. Santa, elves, reindeer, and snowmen show up among the garlands, along with mittens, scarves, snow globes, and pine trees.

Check the mantel, the table, the windowsill, and the edge of the room. Holiday objects sit inside the picture, mixed in with decorations, furniture, and wrapped gifts.

❄️ A calm Christmas hidden object game
Hidden Christmas is a relaxing seek-and-find game for a short break or a longer cozy session. Finish one list, then come back later for another winter scene.

It is an easy holiday puzzle when you want something festive without a timer, and a closer search when you feel like examining every corner. Play for a few minutes, or stay with a picture until the last object turns up.

If you like Christmas games, hidden object puzzles, and holiday seek-and-find pictures, start with one scene and see what you notice.

- Battle & Conquer: Send your duck army into exciting battles! Use your numbers and strategy to defeat enemy squads and win the fight.
- Upgrade & Get Stronger: Earn coins from every victory and use them to expand your army and power up your ducks.

Why You'll Love Duck War
- Simple, Fun Gameplay: Easy-to-understand controls and straightforward mechanics make it easy to jump in and start playing, while every battle keeps you engaged.
- Exciting Army Growth: Watch your duck squad grow as you collect more soldiers and build up a powerful army before each battle.

- Satisfying Battles: See your duck army charge into battle with fun animations and satisfying battle effects.

Build your army. Choose your path. Win the war!

Think you can lead the strongest duck army? Jump into Duck War and start your battle!

android:com.CircleGames.TidyRoom.name: Tidy Room!
android:com.CircleGames.TidyRoom.description:
A bedroom floor full of stray things. A kitchen counter lost under mugs. A study where nothing made it back to the shelf. Tidy Room! hands you the mess and a few baskets, and asks you to put it right.

Each basket names what it wants. Hunt through the room, tap the right things, and watch the clutter disappear. Objects hide under other objects, so the fun is in the order: what do you pick up first?

Play at your own pace. There is no countdown, just a room that looks better every time you find the thing a basket asked for.

What you will do
• Explore illustrated rooms, from quiet studies to busy kitchens
• Fill baskets by finding the items they ask for
• Dig through piles to reach what is hidden underneath
• Plan your taps so the tray does not overflow
• Clear one level and start the next

One room at a time, until the house feels like home again.

android:arrow.puzzle.maze.renovation.gam.name: Arrow Story: Home Design
android:arrow.puzzle.maze.renovation.gam.description:
Welcome to Arrow Story: Home Design! A relaxing arrow puzzle game that trains your brain.
SOS! A woman and her dog lost their home to a fire. A family is caught in a blizzard. They need your help.
Come to Arrow Story: Home Design. Solve arrow puzzles, collect stars, and help people in need rebuild their homes and get back to happy lives.
It's a heartfelt arrow puzzle game where every level brings a change you can see. Spend the stars you earn to repair their broken homes until the place looks new again. One repair at a time, you put their lives back together.
➡️ Arrow Puzzle Gameplay
Arrows cover every grid, and each one can only travel the way it points. That means one arrow can block another. Study the layout, spot which arrows are in the way, and find the order that clears the board.
An arrow leaves once its path is open. Tap a blocked one and it counts as a mistake. Every level pays 1 to 3 stars, and fewer mistakes mean more stars. Stars are your score and your building budget. Every star moves the story forward, and the more you earn, the faster you can build. Fail a level and you lose a heart. Early levels teach the rules. Later ones make you think. Hard and super-hard levels put your planning to the test.
💡 Helpers for Tricky Grids
A tight grid doesn't have to stop you. Four helpers are ready: Hint, Eraser, Magic Wand, and Full Grid Zoom.
✨ Why Choose Arrow Story: Home Design
• ⭐ Arrow puzzles with a real payoff: every grid you clear pays stars
• 🔨 Builds you can see: every repair brings the place closer to new, and helps someone who needs it
• ☕ No rush: no timer, so you can take all the time you need
• 📴 Offline play: works without Wi-Fi or mobile data
Take a break with Arrow Story: Home Design. Calm a restless mind, fill a few spare minutes, ease the pressure of the day, and enjoy a puzzle without stress. Along the way, you help people, follow their stories, and feel what a little help can do.
If you like arrow puzzles, arrow escape games, and stories about helping others, this one is for you.
Someone is waiting. Download Arrow Story: Home Design now and start helping people who need it.

android:com.art.game.jigsaw.glow.name: GlowFit: Jigsaw Makeover Story

Welcome to GlowFit — the ultimate fusion of relaxing Jigsaw Photo Puzzles and dramatic makeover stories! After facing a shocking betrayal on her wedding day, she was left with nothing. Now, she needs YOUR help to rebuild her life, style gorgeous outfits, and get the ultimate revenge by glowing up!

android:com.playstrom.keycap.name: My KeyCap - ASMR Clicker
android:com.playstrom.keycap.description:

android:com.yourstudio.pinkpour.name: Pink Pour: Water Sort
android:com.yourstudio.pinkpour.description:
Welcome to Pink Pour Water Sort, a relaxing water-sort puzzle game built around color sorting and careful pouring.

Your goal is simple: pour colored water between bottles until every bottle contains only one color. Tap a bottle to select it, then tap another bottle to pour the top layer of water. Water can be poured into an empty bottle or onto water of the same color. Each level presents a different color arrangement, so you need to observe the order of colors, use empty bottles wisely, and plan your moves carefully.

Each completed level unlocks an entry in the in-game CG gallery. These CG entries are collectible 2D game illustrations that serve as level-completion rewards. You can view unlocked illustrations in the gallery. The CG gallery is a reward and collection feature, while the core gameplay remains water sorting and color classification.

Game features:

    Water-sort puzzle gameplay: select bottles, pour water, and sort colors.

    Multiple levels with different color arrangements.

    Complete levels to unlock in-game CG illustrations and gallery entries.

    Undo and restart options to help you adjust your strategy.

    Simple tap controls and liquid pouring animations.

    Suitable for short breaks or longer play sessions.

    Play at your own pace and solve each color-sorting puzzle.

Goal:
Separate the mixed colors so that every bottle contains only one color. Complete the current level to unlock the next level and its corresponding CG gallery reward.

This is a casual puzzle game focused on water sorting and color classification. The in-game CG illustrations are level rewards and collection content.

android:com.gameoverflow.seaplayground.name: Sea Playground: Ship Sandbox
android:com.gameoverflow.seaplayground.description:
Nothing is unsinkable — and Sea Playground is here to prove it. This ship sandbox game is a mobile simulation built on real physics. A bomb, a lightning strike, a giant wave or the tentacles of a kraken — you choose how the ship goes down, and no two wrecks are ever the same.

🎮 How it works
1. Pick any unlocked vessel.
2. Tap a tool — from a bomb to the kraken.
3. Watch the hull crack, water pour through every breach, fire break out and the wreck sink all the way to the seabed.

💥 Wrecks you can't look away from
A single wave can snap a lake freighter in half, the kraken can drag a vessel into the deep, and one lightning strike can set off a chain reaction on an LNG tanker. Bombs, lasers and even antimatter reveal the full scale of destruction — from the first crack to the last bubble on the surface. That's the thrill of a true sinking ship simulator.

🚢 A fleet for every taste
With twelve vessels — from an old galleon to the legendary Titanic, from a humble crab boat to a towering cruise liner — this boat sandbox has a ship for every idea. Four are ready to sink from day one; the rest are waiting for their moment.

🌊 An ocean with character
Calm water or rolling waves, day or night — the sea shows every mood. Call a storm and watch the ocean rage. And when the deck lights come on at night, every explosion makes the dark water glow.

🔁 Play your way
No levels, no time limits — just open-ended sandbox gameplay, real physics and your experiments. Sink a ship, restart the scene with a single tap or patch the holes with the repair tool. This sandbox playground is just as good for a quick session on your phone as it is for hours of experimenting.

Sea Playground is a ship sandbox and sinking ship simulator for fans of sandbox games, simulation games and boat games. Unleash a kraken, call a storm, sink the Titanic — and send your first ship to the bottom today.

Links to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy can be found below:
https://freeplay.io/games/android/terms-of-use/
https://freeplay.io/games/android/privacy-policy/

android:com.thunderhorn777.slots.game.name: Wildhorn Gold Slots
android:com.thunderhorn777.slots.game.description:
Wildhorn Gold Slots is a five-reel video slot built for short, relaxed sessions. Winning symbols are removed, the reels drop new ones in, and every further cascade in the same spin pays at a bigger multiplier - so one spin can keep paying.

Every spin is decided on your device. The game runs completely offline, so you can play on a flight, on the subway or anywhere else with no signal.

HOW IT PLAYS
- Five reels, three rows and 10 fixed paylines on every spin
- Cascading reels: winning symbols explode out, new symbols drop in, and each further cascade in that spin pays at x1, x2, x3 and x5
- The golden horn is wild and substitutes for every other symbol
- Mystery wilds: extra wilds can drop on any base-game spin
- Bonus Stars open the free spins, and you choose how to play them:
  - More Spins: 6 free spins with every win doubled
  - Bigger Multiplier: 3 free spins with every win multiplied by four
  - Mystery Wilds: 4 free spins with extra wilds dropping in
  Three or more Bonus Stars during the feature add more spins
- Gold coins fill the coin meter. When it is full the Coin Chests bonus opens and you pick 4 of 12 chests for credit prizes of up to 2x your total bet each
- Four jackpots - MINI, MINOR, MAJOR and GRAND - can drop on any base-game spin, and the pot values follow your bet
- Double up any base-game win on red or black for x2, or take the x3 and x5 ladder
- Eight bet levels, from a 20-credit minimum to a 2000-credit maximum
- Auto-spin for up to 100 spins, with stop conditions: stop on a bonus, on a win above a chosen multiple, or when the balance drops
- Missions: three goals run at a time and pay extra credits when you complete them
- A level meter that grows with everything you wager
- Built-in paytable, session statistics and a list of your last 12 spins
- Synthesised sound effects with a one-tap mute, animated win highlights, cascade counters and big-win celebrations
- Your credit balance, settings and progress are remembered between sessions
- Portrait-only, single-hand controls and a layout that scales to any phone screen

There is nothing to download after install and no connection is required to play. Credits are for entertainment only: this is a simulated slot machine, no real money is wagered, no real money can be won and no cash prizes are offered. The game is intended for adults aged 18 and over.

Pull the lever, land the horn, and see how far the gold takes you.

android:app.streetleaguefootball.name: Street League Football
android:app.streetleaguefootball.description:
Arcade American football on a street field, where every catch, tackle and juke comes from physics. Chase a high score in Endless, take the hit in Tackle Alley, and win 1v1 route battles online or against the CPU.

Players' bodies and the ball actually collide, so no two plays look the same. Run up a wall, go up one-handed over a defender, or truck the tackler and keep going.

MODES
- Endless: CPU opponents get tougher every round. Three strikes and you're out. Play offense, defense or both and climb the global leaderboards.
- Tackle Alley: carry the ball through a lane of tacklers, or line up as the defender and stop the runner.
- Route Battle 1 on 1: receiver against corner, eight reps, roles swap every two. Play online multiplayer with quick match or a room code, or take on four CPU difficulties.
- 3 on 3: squads, rush counts and route calls, online or against the CPU. Still being built.
- Practice: kickoff returns, quarterback drills and route work.

FREE TO START
The free download includes the tutorial, Tackle Alley with one tackler, Route Battle 1 on 1 against Rookie and Street CPU opponents, and the replay editor. One Full Game purchase unlocks Endless, 3 on 3, kickoff returns, quarterback and route practice, online play, more Tackle Alley defenders, and Legend and Insane CPU difficulty. No ads and no subscriptions. Restore Purchases is in Settings.

MORE
- Replay editor: rewatch any play from new camera angles in slow motion, then save and export the clip.
- Locker: build your player's body, head, hair, gear, cleats and colors.
- Touch controls built for landscape, with a layout editor to move every button. Controllers work too.
- Cross-platform online matches.

Online play needs an internet connection and uses Epic Online Services. Found a problem? Use the in-game Feedback button.

android:com.krillion.app.name: Krakio: Daily Trivia Dive
android:com.krillion.app.description:
Krakio is the daily trivia dive where rare answers sink deeper.

Each day brings 7 new trivia prompts. Same quiz for everyone. You have 25 seconds to type one answer. Common answers stay near the surface. Rare answers take you deep.

HOW TO PLAY

• Read the prompt and type any valid answer
• Score points for rarity — every point sinks you 10 metres
• Finish all 7 prompts and see your depth
• Share your dive with friends

One dive per day. No multiple choice. No second chances. Just a fast daily trivia quiz that rewards the answer nobody else typed.

WHY PLAY Krakio
• Fresh daily trivia every day
• Open-ended word quiz — type your own answer
• Rarity scoring: rare sinks, obvious floats
• Depth score down to the trench (700 points)
• Same 7 prompts worldwide so you can compare
• Quick sessions — perfect for a coffee break
• Free daily dive forever

If you like daily trivia, word games, brain teasers, and quiz games with a twist, start your dive in Krakio.

Name the rarest answer. Dive deeper.

Independent app. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any other website or brand.

android:com.F2Games.GB27.name: GoreBox 27
android:com.F2Games.GB27.description:
GoreBox 27 is a physics sandbox shooter. Every character is a GoreDoll: a full ragdoll with its own skeleton, organs and blood.

Play alone, against bots or online with other players.

DAMAGE
• Damage is tracked per body part: broken bones, failing organs and blood loss from each wound
• Lose the arm holding a gun and the gun falls. Lose the legs or break the spine and the GoreDoll crawls
• Knockouts, concussions and bleeding out, with GoreDolls that wake up and get back on their feet
• Blades and axes take off arms, legs and heads, and explosions tear bodies apart
• Wounds and burns stay on bodies, and blood stays on the ground
• Your own character takes the same damage, down to bruises and torn clothing
• The Body Inspector shows a body's vitals and organ function, and Status Indicators show how your character feels

FIRE, EXPLOSIVES AND RADIATION
• Fire spreads through grass, wood, cloth and spilled fuel, and smoke fills rooms and chokes GoreDolls
• GoreDolls catch fire and burn to death unless the fire is put out
• Explosives from propane tanks and gas cans to missiles, the Neutron Bottle and the Aerial Bomb, a nuclear bomb
• Radioactive fallout drifts with the wind, causes radiation sickness and can turn GoreDolls into Mutants

WEAPONS AND PROPS
• Firearms with recoil and handling based on real calibres
• Bullets go through walls, depending on the calibre and the wall's thickness
• 25 melee weapons, from the Katana to the Frying Pan, with heavy swings and blocking
• The Reality Crusher: grab anything physical, fling it, tear it apart or crush it, and build fences and walls
• Over 200 props, including turrets, TVs, live cameras, jump pads and teleporters

BOTS AND NPCS
• Ten kinds of NPC, from Regulars and Officers to Convicts, Maniacs, Mutants and Divines, each with its own background. Some fight back, some run and some surrender
• Bots take cover, react to gunshots, search where they last saw you, fight with melee weapons and man turrets
• Set each NPC's skill, and save an NPC with its weapons, look and side as your own spawn card

MULTIPLAYER
• Crossplay between PC and mobile
• Host a game for friends, invite them from your friends list, or browse public servers
• Dedicated servers, LAN games, voice and text chat, and vote-kicks
• Hosts set the rules, kick players, sell roles and run their server's own money, GB$
• Clans, each with its own bank and emblem

GAMEMODES
• Sandbox, with no rules or objectives
• Free for all, Team deathmatch, Gun Game, Maniac Mystery, Infection, Mutant survival, Juggernaut, Riot, Invasion and more
• Bots can fill in for players in any gamemode
• Make your own gamemodes from triggers and actions, with lives, teams, zones and secret roles

WORLD
• Day and night, with a moon that goes through its phases, and clouds, rain and storms
• A car to drive, which hurts whoever it hits and whoever is inside when it crashes

CREATE YOUR OWN
• Build maps in the Map Editor on PC, with houses, working doors, lifts and water to swim in, and play them straight away
• Publish maps on the Workshop and play the ones other players made
• Save a scene with everything built in it, its NPCs and where everyone stands, and load it again later
• Customise your character down to the face, with hairstyles, beards, hats, masks and clothes in any colour

Full controller support, and touch controls on mobile.

EARLY ACCESS
This is an early access version of GoreBox 27. You will run into bugs, and parts of the game are unfinished or still missing. Nothing you see here is final.

GoreBox 27 is only a few months old and has far less content than GoreBox Animosity for now. New updates will keep adding more. If you find a bug, please report it on our Discord server.

GoreBox 27 contains graphic violence, blood and gore, and online interaction with other players. It is not made for children.

android:com.tripledot.puzzleword.name: Sand Out - Drop Puzzle
android:com.tripledot.puzzleword.description:
Make room, match colours and let the sand flow.

In Sand Out - Drop Puzzle, drag coloured collectors around the board and place them beside matching sand. Watch each collector fill grain by grain, then pop away to open new paths. Clear every collector to complete the puzzle.

Plan your moves around layered colours, different collector shapes and narrow passages. Discover frozen collectors, keys and locks, sand feeders, glass barriers and rocks as you progress. Hammer and magnet boosters can help when you need a fresh approach.

Enjoy colourful sand, gentle water effects and satisfying clears in a puzzle game built around simple controls and thoughtful moves.

How to play:
• Drag collectors into position.
• Match each collector with sand of the same colour.
• Fill and clear collectors to free up space.
• Clear the board to move to the next puzzle.

android:com.azragames.ungodly.name: UnGodly
android:com.azragames.ungodly.description:
UnGodly is a dark fantasy action RPG where you control every strike, dodge and hero swap in real-time combat. Collect Primals, build your team and fight to save a world being devoured.

The world of Dunmiir is broken. The Devouring consumes what remains, and only the Primals, scarred warriors who wield elemental power, stand between humanity and extinction. This is a mature action RPG built for players who want real action, deep progression and a story with teeth.

REAL-TIME ACTION COMBAT
Every fight is in your hands. Dodge enemy attacks, swap heroes mid-battle, chain ultimates and trigger elemental reactions to break your enemies apart. Combat is fast, heavy and bloody: cut down foes, sever heads and limbs, and earn every victory through skill and timing. If you love hack and slash action games, UnGodly delivers combat with real weight.

COLLECT AND BUILD YOUR PRIMALS
Recruit Primals, warriors shaped by trauma and power, each built for a distinct combat role. Level them up, upgrade gear, unlock awakenings and customize skills to create your own builds. This hero collector RPG rewards experimentation: every Primal opens new team synergies and new ways to play.

A DARK FANTASY WORLD WORTH SAVING
Explore Dunmiir, a shattered fantasy realm ruled by dangerous factions and corrupted gods. Follow a mature story told through cinematic missions, side quests and character-driven role play. Every chapter of this dark fantasy RPG pulls you deeper into a world of blood, betrayal and survival.

BOSSES, EVENTS AND THE NETHERMAW DESCENT

Stretch. Squeeze. Hide before the flashlight finds you.

Squeeze is a casual physics puzzle in flat 2D with a side view. You play a ginger jelly cat with a soft body that stretches, spreads out and slips into the tightest gaps. Once night falls, the house becomes your playground, and you knock things off the shelves just to hear them crash.

Puzzle mechanics
• Jelly body — the cat stretches, spreads out and squeezes through narrow gaps
• Vacuum cleaner and skateboard — hop on and ride across the room
• Lasers — slip past the beams without crossing them
• Claw — dodge the claw that reaches into the room
• Noise meter — watch how loud your mischief gets
• Quiet levels — move softly and avoid making any noise
• Patrol — stay out of sight of whoever walks the rounds

Made for soft, sneaky play
The jelly body gives every move a stretchy, playful feel: you pour yourself into a crack, then pull back out on the other side. Because each room has its own mechanic, you keep learning new tricks instead of repeating one. Mischief comes first, and the hiding is the clever part.

Stretch out and slip away before the light finds you.

android:com.ob.eb.bubble.game.description:
Bubble Blitz is a bubble popping puzzle where every level gives you a fixed number of shots to clear the board.

Shoot bubbles at matching colors to make them disappear. A single shot can also cut bubbles loose from whatever they’re hanging on, so they drop off the board even if they don’t match your color.

How to Play:

- Aim your shot and release to send a bubble at the board.
- Match bubbles of the same color to clear them.
- Cut a cluster loose from above to drop extra bubbles at once, matching or not.
- Choose between two bubbles before each shot to pick the color you need.
- Clear every bubble on the board to finish the level.

How to get good at Bubble Blitz

Slow down before each move and read the whole board for the biggest cluster instead of grabbing the closest match. A shot that cuts a big group loose from above often clears more than one that only matches a color. Bounce your shot off a wall to reach an angle a straight shot can’t, and pick between your two available bubbles based on what the board actually needs.

Why play this bubble popping puzzle

Bubble Blitz gives you a real shot count behind the color matching instead of an infinite freeplay mode. It’s a bubble popping puzzle with actual levels to finish, built for a quick round on a break or a longer session at the end of the day. Line up your shot, and see how many bubbles come down with it.

android:com.easybrain.rings.out.game.description:
Rings Out is a relaxing rotate ring game where you turn linked circles, line up their gaps, and free every piece to clear the board. Give each circle a little turn, rotate rings and watch the puzzle come apart!

Settle into a satisfying mix: rotate rings and slide bars, creating space to unlock each piece. One small move can open the way for the next, so take a moment to see how everything connects, and untie the rings! A ring that's stuck now might come free after you shift a bar or turn a neighboring circle. Enjoy working out the sequence at your own pace—this rotate ring game gives you enough time to think.

How to Play Rings Out

- Touch and drag a ring or half-ring to rotate it.
- Align the gaps so linked pieces can be released.
- Check what's blocking each piece and move it out of the way.
- Keep untangling until the board is clear.

A Few Extra Twists

Straight and L-shaped bars add another layer to each puzzle. Slide them back and forth along a fixed line to clear the way and unlock rings. You'll need to think about both turns and slides as you work through the whole arrangement.

When you need a little help, use the bomb booster. It removes one random element from the board, giving you fewer pieces to untangle and making the ring puzzle easier to solve.

Why You'll Love Rings Out

- Relaxing gameplay: Pause, consider your options, and enjoy figuring things out in your own time.
- Simple touch-and-drag controls: Turn and slide pieces with a simple drag of your finger.
- Logic challenges: This ring puzzle, like many other logic games, gives you a chance to train your brain and plan a few moves ahead, putting your observation and planning skills to work.
- Two ways to untangle: Rotate rings and slide bars to find a solution for every level of this circle game.
- Satisfying progress: Enjoy every piece you release, from the first opening to the last ring when a tricky tangle finally comes apart.

How to Master Rings Out

Take a look at the whole board of this circle game before you start turning. Pick a ring and trace what's keeping it locked, then work backward to find your first move. Try moving nearby pieces to create an opening—even a small slide can make room for a useful turn. Think a few moves ahead, experiment, and finally untie the rings!

Take a quiet break and train your logic skills with Rings Out! Rotate rings, slide bars, and discover how the pieces fit together—and how to untangle all of them!

android:com.numhop.app.name: Numhop: Math Puzzle
android:com.numhop.app.description:
Place the tiles. Wire the numbers. Hit every target.

Numhop is a calm math puzzle about numbers that run down a board. Numbers wait at the top, targets sit at the bottom, and every target needs its own number. Connect them with operation tiles and splitters, then watch the numbers hurry along the wires, adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing on the way.

How it works
Pick the tiles you need, place them on the board and draw wires between them. Each number follows the wires and changes at every tile it passes. Once each target receives the number it asks for, the level is solved. Solve it with fewer tiles and you earn more stars.

Puzzle mechanics
• Operation tiles — add, subtract, multiply or divide the number that passes through
• Splitters — fork a wire so one number can travel to several places
• Wires — link numbers, tiles and targets to build the route
• Star rating — fewer tiles used means more stars for the level
• Multi-answer targets — some targets accept several different numbers, so more than one solution works
• Walls, fractions and negatives — later boards add obstacles and numbers below zero or between whole ones

Made for calm thinking
The game has 33 levels. A short tutorial comes first, then the puzzles get more interesting. There are no timers, so you can think each wire through at your own pace. A wrong move is easy to take back with undo, and if a board leaves you stuck, the game can show the solution.

Place a tile, connect a wire and let the numbers hop.

FAMILIAR SYMBOLS, FRESH PUZZLES

HOW TO PLAY

• Look for tiles with identical symbols.
• Move tiles into position to create valid pairs.
• Remove matching pairs to open more space.
• Keep matching until the board is clear.

android:com.magichexa.sort.name: Magic Hexa
android:com.magichexa.sort.description:
Sort vibrant hexagonal stacks and train your logic in Magic Hexa, a color sort puzzle with a fresh geometric twist.

Magic Hexa takes the familiar tube-sorting mechanic and replaces liquid with tactile stacks of colorful hex tiles. Guided by a helpful raccoon companion, you transfer matching layers between transparent glass flasks until each tube contains only one uniform color. Plan your transfers carefully, manage empty flasks wisely, and solve increasingly complex color layouts.

Key mechanics:
• Hex stack sorting: Tap a flask to lift the top single-color layer and drop it onto matching tiles or into an empty tube.
• Progressive difficulty: Advance through stages that introduce more flasks, intricate color combinations, and extra layers.
• Crystal rewards: Clear levels to earn crystals and mark your progression.

Organize every stack and master every stage in Magic Hexa.

android:com.candyjam.game.name: Sweet Up!
android:com.candyjam.game.description:
Sweet Up! — Candy & Block Puzzle

Slide the blocks, fill them with candy, and solve every puzzle! Sweet Up! is a relaxing, free-to-play candy puzzle game that combines the satisfying feel of block-sliding games with a brand-new candy drop mechanic you haven't seen before.

Slide colorful cube blocks to open a path, then watch as piles of candy beans drop, tumble and fill their matching color blocks. Simple, one-finger controls make it easy to pick up, but each level brings a fresh logic challenge that will keep your brain busy.

WHY PLAY SWEET UP!

✔ A unique candy-drop mechanic that is so satisfying to watch — no other block puzzle game plays quite like this
✔ Bright, sweet visuals with satisfying candy bean physics
✔ Simple slide block controls, easy for all ages
✔ Hundreds of hand-crafted puzzle levels
✔ New block types and obstacles as you progress
✔ Hidden Pixel Art: Clear the board to reveal fun pixel-art pictures made of candy
✔ Race the clock and sharpen your puzzle-solving speed
✔ Helpful boosters — Time Freeze, Scoop and Vacuum — for the trickiest levels

HOW TO PLAY

Slide the blocks on the board to clear out a path. Fill each block with candy beans of its matching color before time runs out. Some paths are trickier than others — plan your moves carefully, because one wrong slide can block the candy and cost you the puzzle!

WHO IS THIS GAME FOR?

If you enjoy block puzzle games, candy games, color match games, sort puzzles, or relaxing brain games and logic puzzles, Sweet Up! is your next favorite puzzle game. It's perfect for a quick coffee-break puzzle or a long relaxing session before bed.

Download Sweet Up! now, free to play, and let the candy drop!

android:com.agavegames.hexaword.name: Hexa Word - Relaxing Puzzle
android:com.agavegames.hexaword.description:
Hexa Word is a cozy word puzzle made for every word lover!

Slide your finger across the hexagon letter tiles to build words and complete the hidden word list. Every letter has to touch the next one, so study the honeycomb board and trace the right path. It's a fresh take on crosswords and word search games. Need a little help? Some words reveal their first letter to get you started.

Hexa Word takes seconds to pick up, yet keeps you thinking level after level. Take as long as you like, because nothing is rushing you. Just you, the letters, and a peaceful moment to yourself.

Hundreds of puzzles are waiting for you, each one a little trickier than the last. Explore lovely scenes like snowy mountains, quiet lakes and golden fields while you play. Discover new words, give your brain a daily workout, and unwind after a long day. Kids, parents and grandparents can all enjoy it together.

Get Hexa Word today and see how many words you can find!

android:com.alexb.skyscraper.name: Skyscraper Simulator
android:com.alexb.skyscraper.description:
🏙️ FROM THE GROUND FLOOR TO THE CLOUDS

An empty lot in the heart of a big city, a small lobby and a building crew ready to go. What rises here is up to you. Build floor by floor, up into the sky and down below the street, plan every room, run elevators and utilities — and turn that little lobby into a skyscraper full of life. A cozy pixel-art building sim where every floor follows your plan.

🏗️ THE SITE IS BUZZING

Every floor rises before your eyes: a steel frame, scaffolding, bricks and beams, and a tower crane with a load swinging on its hook. Builders in hard hats and hi-vis vests hammer away, tighten bolts and drill from their ladders. Hire more workers, speed them up, and watch your tower grow even faster.

📐 YOUR TOWER, YOUR PLAN

Over 50 kinds of rooms: apartments and lofts, offices and coworking spaces, cafes, restaurants, a gym, a cinema, a spa, even a hotel. Place them however you like, tear down and rebuild. But location matters: a cafe on a busy floor draws more guests, offices work better side by side, apartments are worth more up high, and greenery gives the neighbours a bonus. A smart layout means more income.

⚡ KEEP IT RUNNING

Generators and pumps, substations and water plants, a server room, security and recycling — the taller the tower, the bigger the job. Add elevator shafts and new stops, research express elevators and new tech. Find where the tower is stuck, fix it, and watch it run like clockwork.

🔨 UPGRADE AND RENOVATE

Every room can be upgraded, and the best ones renovated into pure luxury: gold cornices, crystal lamps and paintings in golden frames. Elevators get a new look for the shaft and car with every level, and stairwells turn into escalators.

🌆 LANDMARK PROJECTS

The most ambitious builds are still ahead: a metro station with trains pulling in, a pool in the clouds, a sky restaurant with a balcony over the city, a luxury penthouse at the very top — and even an archaeological dig. It turns up everything from old coins to a dinosaur skeleton, and every find goes on display in your tower's museum.

👥 A LIVING TOWER

Everything you build comes to life. Every resident has a unique name and look: in the morning people rush to work and queue for the elevator, in the evening the windows light up, at night the tower falls asleep. Taxis zip along the street, and now and then a limo pulls up with a very important guest.

Your neighbours often need a hand: sparking wires, a burst pipe, lost keys. Over 50 mini-games — solve the puzzles and collect the rewards.

🎯 ALWAYS ROOM TO GROW

Foreman Max shows you the ropes, then dozens of goals, daily tasks and new levels keep you going. The more residents you have, the more rewards and new rooms you unlock. Stepped away? Construction keeps going, and your accountant greets you with an income report.

Start with one lobby — and see how high you can go. 🏙️

android:com.manerai.scaryhotdog.name: Scary Hot Dogs: Horror Game
android:com.manerai.scaryhotdog.description:
Scary Hot Dogs is a survival horror game where you run a small street food stand, prepare orders, and serve creepy customers. What begins as a normal night shift soon turns into a series of strange encounters, unexpected scares, and mysterious events. Not every customer is here for a hot dog...

Serve Your Customers 🌭
Take orders, prepare hot dogs, and serve hungry customers. Cooking hot dogs may sound simple, but things get complicated when your customers aren't quite what they seem. This scary work simulator blends everyday tasks with the tension of horror cooking.

Meet Terrifying Characters 👀
Encounter creepy characters who watch your every move, chase you, and turn an ordinary shift into a nightmare. Stay alert as you try to keep your stand running while things get stranger around you.

Survive the Night 💀
Brace yourself for horror nights filled with jumpscares, strange encounters, and unexplained events. Stay focused, complete your tasks, and make it through another night shift. In this survival horror game, even a routine order can lead to a frightening surprise.

Earn Money & Complete Tasks 💰
Serve customers, complete tasks, and earn money to keep your hot dog stand in business. Balance the demands of horror cooking with the challenge of making it through the night. Can you handle everything your shift throws at you?

🌭 Key Features
- Cook and serve hot dogs
- Meet bizarre and terrifying customers
- Experience jumpscares and unexpected events
- Complete tasks and earn money
- Survive horror nights full of strange encounters
- Uncover the mystery behind your unusual customers

Into horror games? Step behind the counter and find out what happens when an ordinary job takes a terrifying turn. In this spooky game, the orders keep coming, the customers get stranger, and every shift tests your nerves. If creepy games and scary games are your thing, see if you can make it through the night!

android:com.dynawave.bf.gb.gp.name: Happy Fishing Village
android:com.dynawave.bf.gb.gp.description:
Ready to dive into a fin-tastic adventure? 
Welcome to your very own little fishing village, where every catch brings a new surprise! Cast your net, catch colorful fish, build a charming seaside town, and turn your tiny harbor into a thriving fishing paradise!
Whether you're chasing a big catch, growing your village, or hanging out with adorable animal friends, there's always something fun waiting by the sea. Take it easy, enjoy the ocean breeze, and create your own happy fishing life!
--What a Catch!
There's always something exciting beneath the waves! Cast your net, reel in amazing catches, and discover the joy of fishing. You never know what you'll catch next!
-- Catch More Fish!
Explore the sparkling blue waters and catch all kinds of colorful fish! Fill your nets, discover new species, and enjoy the thrill of a great catch.
-- Build Your Village!
Start with a tiny fishing village and make it your own! Restore and upgrade buildings, expand your harbor, and watch your little seaside town grow into a bustling paradise.
--Earn and Grow!
Turn your fishing adventures into a thriving business! Collect rewards, grow your earnings, and unlock exciting upgrades to make your village bigger and better.
 --Meet Your Pals!
Life is better with cute companions! Meet adorable animal friends, collect your favorites, and fill your seaside adventure with even more joy.

Your dream fishing village is just one catch away! 
Catch fish, build your village, make new friends, and enjoy the simple pleasures of life by the sea.
Ready to make a splash? Your fishing adventure starts now!

android:com.eyestorm.grabcathospital.name: Grab Cat Hospital
android:com.eyestorm.grabcathospital.description:
Welcome to Grab Cat Hospital, a fun and addictive physics puzzle game where you'll meet strange, unique cats that never seem to stay still!

Your mission is simple: pull the cat to the finish line. But these cats are anything but ordinary! They have unexpected behaviors, funny personalities, and a stubborn attitude. Tap and hold to pull the cat forward, but the moment you let go, it will immediately run back to where it started!

Stay patient, plan your route, and pull the cat through all kinds of obstacles to reach the finish safely. Don't let their unusual looks fool you—these adorable cats are full of surprises!

Every level features a new layout filled with obstacles, traps, and hilarious situations. Observe carefully, master your timing, and find the best way to guide these quirky cats to the finish line.

With simple one-touch controls and satisfying physics-based gameplay, Grab Cat Hospital is easy to play but increasingly challenging to master.

GAME FEATURES

• Tap and hold to pull strange cats forward.
• Release your finger, and the cat runs back!
• Every cat has a unique look and funny reactions.
• Every level brings a brand-new challenge.
• Dodge obstacles and overcome unexpected situations.
• Master your timing and route to reach the finish.
• Simple controls that are easy to learn but hard to master.
• Funny animations and unexpected character reactions.
• Smooth physics-based gameplay.
• Hundreds of unique and challenging levels.

Every level brings a new surprise. Cats can run, bounce, get pulled back, or do things you never expected. Test your reflexes, improve your timing, and figure out the best way to control these unpredictable characters!

No two levels are exactly alike. As you progress, the obstacles become more unpredictable, and the cats become... even stranger!

Whether you love puzzle games, casual games, physics-based challenges, or simply enjoy cats with personalities like no other, Grab Cat Hospital delivers a fun and surprising experience that will keep you coming back for more.

Can you pull all the strange cats to the finish line?

Download Grab Cat Hospital now and discover the most unique cats around!

android:com.pid.lilguardsman.name: Lil' Guardsman
android:com.pid.lilguardsman.description:
Enjoy 10% off during the first two weeks after launch!

👋 Hi, I'm Lil! I'm 12 years old, and today I’m on gate guard duty. What’s that? You don’t think it’s appropriate for a kid to decide who should, and shouldn’t enter the kingdom? You don’t think a 12 year old should be able to send people to the dungeon!? You and me both! But my dad left me in charge, so I guess I don’t have a choice. 
Between shady goblins, haughty elves, and sketchiest of all… humans, I have to conduct interrogations, uncover plots, and survive my shift. Approve, deny, or jail, the fate of the city literally rests on my pre-teen shoulders!

⚖️ Lil’ Guardsman is a comedic, fantasy riff on the border control genre. Every visitor who shows up at the guard shed is a real puzzle that will put your deduction skills to the test. The player must choose to follow, or break, the kingdom’s rules to inspect travelers, identify deception, and make strategic choices.

🪄 As Lil, you must use your wits to outsmart the deceptions of a colorful cast of characters. Letting the wrong person in, or incorrectly sending someone straight to the dungeon, can radically change the course of history, unleashing chaos upon the city. Your individual decisions shape an epic story across twelve levels, a wedding, and a war (that you trigger!) 
 
⚙️ GAME FEATURES

• Full Premium Game: Pay once to unlock the entire adventure. No ads, no microtransactions, no virtual currency.

• Border Post Simulation: Over 100 unique characters to meet, interrogate, and decide the fate of, according to evolving security rules.

• Deduction Mechanics: Use an upgradeable arsenal of tools (Truth Spray, Whip, Metal Detector, and more) with limited uses per day (resource management).

• Interrogation System: Choose your dialogue carefully. Confiscate contraband items, call royal advisors to verify information, and make the final choice to Admit, Deny, or Jail.

• Branching Narrative: Your decisions at the castle gates have direct consequences for the main characters, the kingdom of the Sprawl, and the game's ultimate ending.

• Technical Compatibility: Solo experience optimized for touch screens, 100% playable offline (no internet connection required after the initial installation).

🏅 CRITICAL ACCLAIM AND AWARDS (PC VERSION)
Building on its PC success, Lil' Guardsman has been widely praised by critics and has shined in indie festivals:

🏆 IndieCade Festival: Winner of the Best Performance award for its excellent voice cast.

🏆 Game Development World Championship (GDWC): Winner of the prestigious Studio Award and finalist in the Best Adventure Game, Best Music, and Immersive Audio categories.

🏆 Indie Cup: Winner of the Critics' Choice Award.

⭐ Notable Nominations: Nominated for Best Debut Game at the Indie Games Awards, praised for its plot ("Outstanding Story-Rich Game") at the Steam Awards, and nominated in multiple categories at the Canadian Game Awards (including Game of the Year).

android:com.spellgarden.thriftybusiness.name: Thrifty Business
android:com.spellgarden.thriftybusiness.description:
[TRY BEFORE YOU BUY]
Try the first 60 minutes of Thrifty Business for free! If you like it, you can unlock the full game with a one-time purchase!

There’s a brand new thrift store in town, and guess what? You’re in charge!

In Thrifty Business, you’ll set up and manage your very own 90’s-inspired vintage thrift shop. Search through boxes filled with pre-loved gems and use them to create gorgeous displays. Unlock furniture, decorations, wallpaper & floors to create a beautiful community space that brings everybody together!

Adjust your layout and organize your shelves and racks to the finest detail. Group your wares by colour, theme, purpose, or whatever you like. The more organized your store is, the more community points you’ll get to unlock new goodies!

Customize the furniture, wallpaper, flooring and decor to make your store as welcoming and cozy as possible. As business grows, you might even need to expand into the adjacent rooms!

This is so much more than just a store. Listen to customer’s stories and try to fulfill their requests. You can also unlock and host hobbyist events, turning your business into a treasured third space for locals!

🛍️ What Thrifty Business has in store for you:
- laid-back management sim
- colorful 90s-inspired graphics
- 500+ different items to add to your shelves
- precision placing so you can organize exactly how you want
- customization options: furniture, decorations, wallpaper & flooring
- a quirky and unique cast of customers

🙅‍♀️ What you won’t find on our shelves:
- stressful min-maxing to get the best possible profit
- setting item prices or haggling
- impatient customers that leave your store in anger

android:com.playdigious.absolum.name: Absolum
android:com.playdigious.absolum.description:
A magical cataclysm left magic mistrusted by the common folk and Sun King Azra took advantage of this panic, enslaving wizards through his Crimson Order and conquering more and more lands. With the help of high enchantress Uchawi, a small group of rebels rises from the shadows.

Fight as the outcast heroes of Talamh in a fierce battle to retake magic from Sun King Azra’s grasp in Absolum, an original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu.

FEATURES

​🌌 Join the rebellion! With the help of the high enchantress Uchawi, wield forbidden magic to free the lands of Talamh from the iron grip of Sun King Azra.

⚔️ Four heroes, each with their own fighting style: start playing as the calm but deadly Galandra or as Karl, the last free dwarf of Talamh, and discover the prodigious Brome and the enigmatic Cider as they join your journey.

💥 Craft new strategies and get more powerful every run to defeat Azra’s elite guard through a gameplay that blends the best of arcade beat’em up action with modern roguelite mechanics.

​🗺️ -From the majestic mines of Grandery to the lush forests of Jaroba, delve into an original fantasy world that comes alive through gorgeous art, masterful animation and a magnificent soundtrack by composer Gareth Coker (Ori, Halo Infinite, Prince of Persia), featuring collaborations with other legendary composers.

​🤝 Lead the uprising against Azra's regime as a lone hero, or team up with an ally through the two-player online coop mode. Combine your elemental powers and synchronize your attacks into incredible chained combos!

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Google Play Games achievements
-Buy once, play anywhere: Enjoy cross-progression on mobile and PC with the same Google Play Games account
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between Android devices
-Compatible with controllers

android:com.Doborog.CloneDroneInTheDange.name: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone
android:com.Doborog.CloneDroneInTheDange.description:
Clone Drone in the Danger Zone is a robot voxel slice-em-up where any part of your body can be sliced off. With your mind downloaded into a robot gladiator, you must survive the sinister trials of the arena. You can finally play the indie action hit on the go. It's Clone Drone on your mobile phone!

Single Player Game Modes

• Story Mode - One part epic tale of human defiance, another part laser swords.
• Endless Mode - Challenge yourself to fight through 86 level variants spread across 7 difficulty tiers. Can you make it to TITANIUM?
• Challenge Mode - Bow-only, hammer-only, can you still survive the arena?

Multiplayer Game Modes

• Last Bot Standing - A Battle-Royale-like game mode with short, 5-10 minute play sessions and up to 15 players. Survive, and shower in the remains of your fellow robot competitors.
• Private Duels - Challenge your friend to a 1v1 duel!
• Online Co-op! - Use the power of human friendship (and laser swords!) to survive in the arena!

Features:

• Epic Voxel Dismemberment: In addition to looking cool, the ability to cut off body parts is central to the gameplay. Jumping on one leg is a common occurrence. Large enemies need to be cut down to size before a fatal blow can be delivered.
• Sharp Sword Combat: Combat is fast and intense, putting great emphasis on movement, timing and positioning. You are never safe, as any blow can instantly kill or dismember.
• Intuitive Controls: On-screen buttons allow you to smoothly jump, dash, and destroy any robot adversary.
• Spin Attack: Perform a deadly 360 spin in this mobile exclusive attack!
• Entertaining Commentary: Commentatron and Analysis-Bot provide a play-by-play of your performance and react to your activities.
• Upgrade Your Robot: Jetpack, bow, kicking, deflection, clones, armor, FIRE BREATH.
• Terrifying Robotic Enemies: They actually get pretty hard! Sword robots, bow robots, Spidertron 5000, Spidertron 6000, gigantic hammer bots. So many things to dismember.
• Achievements! Unlock upgrades, emotes and multiplayer skins by achieving a rich variety of things!
• Emotes! Do the Funky Pillar Dance, mock your foes, or flap your arms delightfully!

android:com.fundaygames.boosterpack.name: Booster Pack Heroes
android:com.fundaygames.boosterpack.description:
*Buy the game now to get a special 30% launch discount ($6.99 instead of $9.99)!*

Booster Pack Heroes is an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Discover heroes and spells, upgrade their abilities, and survive endless monster hordes as you fight your way through the realms.

OPEN PACKS
Rip open booster packs, each with its own pool of heroes and spells. Hunt for rare cards and build a collection powerful enough to crush the toughest foes.

UPGRADE YOUR POWER
Survive to earn Mastery. Use it to upgrade your heroes and spells, unlock powerful new abilities, and turn your collection into an unstoppable force.

SURVIVE THE HORDE
Monsters are coming for the tower. Fight through increasingly dangerous waves, unleash devastating abilities, and push your survival as far as you can.

TRAVEL BETWEEN REALMS
Defeat each chapter's boss to unlock new booster packs, heroes, spells, and challenges. Every run feeds the next, giving you more power and letting you survive a bit longer.
…and there's more to discover beyond the tower. Travel between mysterious planes of existence, each with its own secrets.

The cycle has repeated countless times.
You're here to break it.

android:com.bandainamcoent.op_restaurant.name: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
android:com.bandainamcoent.op_restaurant.description:
ONE PIECE comes to life as a restaurant management sim game!

As a new staff member, work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to turn the second location of the renowned Baratie floating restaurant into the greatest restaurant of the seas!

-Dish Out a Signature Menu
Get inspired by characters' ideas, choose your ingredients, and work with Sanji to cook delicious dishes. Arrange them into unique meal sets by adding different flourishes, then adventure to find even more recipes! From iconic series favorites like Water-Water Meat BBQ and Sea King Penne Gorgonzola to special creations that harness the powers of Devil Fruits, a treasure trove of dishes awaits.

Choose from over 200 furniture, building, and decorative items to make your restaurant uniquely yours! From dessert-themed Whole Cake Island pieces to futuristic Egghead items, the customization options are as vast as the sea. If a character likes your design, they may even become a regular!

android:com.theroottrees.android.name: The Roottrees are Dead
android:com.theroottrees.android.description:
INCLUDES A SECOND MYSTERY: ROOTREEMANIA

IT’S THE LATE ’90s

A private jet belonging to the Roottree Corporation has crashed. On board were the three Roottree sisters and their parents—together worth more than a billion dollars.

Under the eccentric wishes of their great-great-grandfather, Elias Roottree, the family fortune must now be divided among every surviving blood relative.

But who is actually related by blood?

That’s where you come in.

SEARCH THE EARLY INTERNET

Use a dial-up-era computer to search archived websites, old newspapers, interviews, advertisements, photographs, books, and other records. Look for names, faces, dates, occupations, and connections.

CROSS-REFERENCE EVERY CLUE

Compare details across different sources. A single discovery may reveal a forgotten relative, expose a hidden relationship, or unlock an entirely new branch of the family.

REBUILD THE FAMILY TREE

Place each person where they belong. Every correct deduction narrows the possibilities—but as the tree grows, the evidence becomes harder to find and the relationships more difficult to prove.

TRUST YOUR REASONING

Read closely, take notes, connect the facts, and decide where to investigate next. Your only tools are an old computer, careful observation, and deductive logic.

FEATURES

• Search a richly detailed recreation of the late-90s internet
• Identify people through photographs, articles, and scattered records
• Cross-reference names, occupations, relationships, and timelines
• Complete and verify an ever-expanding family tree
• Uncover the secrets hidden within the Roottree bloodline

Every correct name brings you closer to the truth—and perhaps to an even greater lie.

Can you complete the Roottree family tree?


CONTACT US
support.m@indieark.com

android:com.payonce.chess.name: ChessGame
android:com.payonce.chess.description:
Learn chess, play chess offline against the computer and solve chess puzzles — all in one app. ChessGame teaches complete beginners how to play chess, then gives you a real chess engine to beat at 6 levels. No ads, no account, no Wi-Fi needed.

♛ LEARN CHESS STEP BY STEP — FROM BEGINNER TO WINNER
Never played before? Start at move one. The Learn course takes you through 21 chapters and 58 chess lessons: how the pieces move, check and checkmate, castling, en passant and pawn promotion, then chess tactics like forks and pins, and the opening principles strong players use. Every lesson has a live chess board with the legal squares highlighted, and every chapter ends with a short test. Get one wrong and ChessGame shows you the right move — like a patient chess coach in your pocket.

♚ PLAY CHESS VS COMPUTER — 6 AI LEVELS
Play chess against the computer from Beginner to Master, or set an exact Elo rating for a custom challenge. The chess AI runs on your phone, so it answers instantly, even in airplane mode. Beginners get an opponent they can beat; experienced players get a strong engine that punishes every mistake. Play white, black or random, ask for a hint when you're stuck, and take back a move.

♞ CHESS PUZZLES & TACTICS TRAINER
Train your tactics with a daily puzzle and random puzzles — back-rank mates, forks, pins and other classic checkmate patterns — with instant feedback on every move.

♜ CHESS OPENINGS
Explore 42 named openings, from the Italian Game and Ruy López to the Sicilian Defense, and play each line on a live board to learn the ideas behind the moves.

♝ 2 PLAYER CHESS ON ONE DEVICE
Play chess with a friend or family member. Pass and play with a full move list, captured pieces and a flip-board button.

🏆 DAILY GOALS, STREAKS & BADGES
Finish a daily goal to build your streak, unlock badges and earn diamonds to spend on hints and take-backs. Turn on a gentle daily reminder if you like.

✨ A CLASSIC CHESS BOARD, BEAUTIFULLY MADE
• Warm wooden classic board with a full-screen mode and one-tap landscape
• 9 board themes and 10 piece sets
• Clear highlights for your selected piece, legal moves and the last move

With its minimalist aesthetic and satisfying tactile feedback, it takes just seconds to learn. Yet, long after you put your phone down, its elegant logic loop will keep lingering in your mind. SORT STREAK: COLOR PUZZLE

Sort, match, and arrange colorful flowers in a satisfying sorting puzzle adventure!

Sort Streak is a relaxing color sorting puzzle game and matching game that combines simple drag-and-drop gameplay with thoughtful planning. Colorful flowers are arranged on ropes, and your goal is to sort flowers by color, match them to the right rope, complete objectives, and fill flower pots.

The gameplay is easy to learn, but every move matters. Rearrange the flowers, manage limited rope space, and find the best solution for every puzzle level. Whether you want to relax or train your logical thinking, Sort Parade offers a colorful and satisfying puzzle challenge.

HOW TO PLAY

• Pick up a flower or a connected group of flowers from a rope.
• Drag the flowers onto an empty rope.
• You can also place them onto a rope with the same color at its free end and enough space.
• Sort and match flowers by color while carefully planning each move.
• Complete a full group of flowers on the matching rope.
• Watch the completed group collect into a flower pot.
• Complete all objectives and fill the required pots to clear the level.

Every move can change the entire board. Look ahead, rearrange the flowers, and use the available rope space wisely. If there are no legal moves left, the level ends. Can you overcome every sorting challenge and complete the objectives?

WHY YOU’LL LOVE SORT STREAK

• Relaxing color sorting gameplay that is easy to learn.
• Simple drag-and-drop controls for an intuitive matching game experience.
• Colorful flowers, ropes, and satisfying sorting animations.
• Puzzle levels ranging from easy introductions to challenging arrangements.
• Different levels and layouts that keep the sorting adventure fresh.
• Helpful tools, including Hint, Undo, and Add a Rope.
• Satisfying flower grouping and flower pot collection feedback.
• A casual puzzle game for a quick break or a longer gameplay session.
• A fun way to practice logical thinking, spatial planning, and problem-solving.

SPECIAL PUZZLE MECHANICS

Mystery Flowers add surprise to your color sorting adventure. Move the flowers underneath to bring a Mystery Flower to the end of the rope and reveal its true color. Once revealed, the flower can be sorted and matched according to the color rules.

Locked Flowers create new obstacles and objectives. Locked flowers cannot be moved until you complete the required color objective or the required number of group objectives. Unlock new possibilities, rearrange the ropes, and find a way through each challenging puzzle level.

As you progress, the flower arrangements become more complex. You will need to read the flower order, overcome obstacles, manage limited space, and choose every move carefully.

SORT, MATCH, AND TRAIN YOUR BRAIN

Sort Streak gives you a peaceful break while encouraging logical thinking, spatial planning, and problem-solving. Take your time to sort colorful flowers, match the right colors, complete objectives, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of solving a puzzle.

Whether you enjoy sorting games, matching games, color sorting puzzles, brain teasers, or casual puzzle games, Sort Parade offers an easy-to-learn experience with satisfying challenges for every puzzle fan.

Can you sort every flower, overcome every obstacle, unlock every possibility, fill every flower pot, and complete the parade? 
Start playing Sort Streak today and enjoy a colorful sorting puzzle adventure!

ios:6769314786.name: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle
ios:6769314786.description:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one hand
-  No timer, no pressure - relax at your own pace
- Levels designed to surprise - no two boards look the same
- 2× speed mode for snappier ant action

EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO STOP.
Early levels are breezy. Later levels pack in more colors, tighter slots, and bigger images that demand real planning.

Which color do you clear first? When do you free a slot before it jams? Every tap matters.

A true logic brain teaser - wrapped in pixel art you'll actually enjoy destroying.

WHY YOU CHOOSE FOOD HUNT?
Most color sort games show you an empty grid and ask you to fill it. Food Hunt flips it - every board starts full, alive with pixel art, and your only goal is to wipe it clean.
Same satisfying sort. A completely different feeling. 

Download Food Hunt - the color sort puzzle where the art is the game.

ios:6754059516.name: Bus Crowd - Traffic Jam
ios:6754059516.description:
Welcome to Bus Crowd, a colorful bus puzzle game built around traffic jam strategy, passenger matching, and smart parking choices. 

A crowded station is full of waiting passengers, and buses with different colors and seat capacities are ready to roll. Check the crowd, choose the right vehicle, then move it into an available parking slot for boarding. Fill every seat to release that slot, avoid a parking jam, and keep each Bus Crowd under control.

How to Play
- Match Colors and Seats: Empty buses enter the boarding slots to pick up waiting passengers of the same color. Each vehicle has its own capacity, so compare the crowd before making a move.
- Follow the Arrows: Move buses from the station into parking slots. Each vehicle can only drive in its arrow direction, so blocked paths need careful observation.
- Fill Buses to Open Slots: A full vehicle departs and opens its parking space for another move. Avoid leaving buses that are not fully filled in the slots for too long.
- Solve the Jam with Strategy: Use color sort logic, bus sort thinking, and car parking style planning to handle every traffic puzzle. 
- Use Boosters When Stuck: Helpful boosters can adjust buses, guide passengers, or open paths when a tricky jam blocks your progress. 

Game Features
- Bus Jam Puzzle Fun: Mix color matching, passenger boarding, parking slots, and traffic jam choices in a challenge that feels easy to start and satisfying to solve.
- Bus Out Challenge: Study the arrows, send the right vehicles out of crowded layouts, and enjoy the moment when a blocked station finally starts moving.
- Bus Escape Moments: Fill buses, open lanes, and create clever escape style solutions as each full vehicle leaves the station.
- Traffic Escape Challenge: Handle car jam inspired layouts, parking jam pressure, and bus rush moments with careful observation instead of random moves.
- Brain Teaser Levels: Count seats, compare passengers, and use smart strategy to solve each puzzle with a real sense of progress.
- Passenger Matching Flow: Watch large crowds stream into colorful buses, see vehicles depart one by one, and turn chaos into a smooth boarding flow.
- Diverse Boosters: Use different tools for buses and passengers, then decide which option gives the best value when the station gets tricky.
- Bright 3D Station Scenes: Enjoy vivid buses, lively passengers, smooth boarding animations, and relaxing traffic flow.

Bus Crowd is a colorful puzzle where every move counts. Match passengers with the right buses, open parking spaces, and keep traffic flowing through increasingly clever challenges. Perfect for fans of bus games, parking games, and traffic jam puzzles. Download Bus Crowd and clear the way!

· Cognitive workout for sequencing and brain teasers

Made for the in-between moments

- The metro ride too short for a podcast 
- The flight where your signal drops
- The wind-down after a noisy workday 
  
Amaze GO! - Puzzle Games is a calm arrow puzzle made for sharp minds and calm moments. Learn fast, then master timing and order. android:com.combo.yarnflow.name: Yarn Loop: Knit Puzzle
android:com.combo.yarnflow.description:
Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
 
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.
