Factifact is a trivia word puzzle that turns fun facts into wordplay. 🔍 Each short fact hides some of its words inside brackets. Read the definitions, find the missing words and reveal the whole fact.
 
How does a Factifact word game work? A fact appears with some words, or parts of words, hidden in brackets. Each bracket holds a short definition of a missing word. Read it and guess the word from four options. No typing is needed, so these logic puzzles stay smooth and focused. Definitions are nested three or four layers deep. The answer to an inner definition becomes a word in the outer one. It feels like trivia questions stacked inside each other. Every word you find brings you closer to interesting facts about the world. 🧠 Think of them as word riddles that test your vocabulary.
 
Factifact works like a reverse crossword without a grid. ⛏️ Classic crossword puzzles give you a clue and a row of empty squares. Here you start from the clue and dig down to the hidden word. Fans of word puzzle games will feel at home right away. Every brainteaser blends vocabulary, reasoning and general knowledge in one sequence. Short brain teasers like these make a calm mental workout at any time.
 
Guess the word correctly and the next layer of the puzzle opens. Unlike most word quiz games, every answer becomes part of the next clue. These trivia questions reward careful reading and patient thinking. Solving puzzles here feels like piecing a small story together. What you will find inside:
💡 A hint when a clue feels too tricky
❤️ Three hearts per fact, so every guess counts
🏺 A dig site that uncovers a hidden find with each solved word
📌 A board where every solved fact is pinned as a colorful note
🎉 Confetti, fireworks and kind words when a fact is fully revealed
 
The facts cover nature, geography, animals and much more. 🏺 One puzzle explains why honey can stay fresh for centuries. Another shows how Mount Everest is still growing. If you enjoy crossword puzzles, these little discoveries will surprise you. Factifact brings word puzzle games and general knowledge together. Expect brain teasers that are short, fair and satisfying to crack.
 
Facts unlock one after another, and any solved fact can be reread later. 📌 Some logic puzzles are gentle, while others are real brainteasers with deep nesting. A wrong answer costs a heart, so read each clue carefully. Love word quiz games, solving puzzles and interesting facts? 🎉 Factifact is waiting for you.

• Auto-sweep — a robot vacuum, then a cat, pushes rubble into the crusher
• Special blocks — armor, sand, glass, ice and gold change how a wall breaks and pays
• LOCKDOWN — every tenth room has a chained armored door to break in 45 seconds while lava rises

Built for steady progress
Helpers keep working while you are away, and a While you were away window shows the coins they earned. Items change their look as they level up: a plain wooden bat becomes a golden one with spikes and a chain. android:find.tidy.house.sort.puzzle.game.name: Tidy House: Find Objects
android:find.tidy.house.sort.puzzle.game.description:
Casual games like Tidy House offer simple tap controls and short rounds. Find items in a cluttered room, tap to collect them, and watch the room get tidier with each move. If you enjoy hidden object games, find objects on the list and collect them by category. Need one more shirt? Find it to finish a group. In this sorting puzzle, every group you complete brings you closer to a tidy room.

HOW TO PLAY

Look, tap, and collect
To finish with a tidy room, find items that fit the targets shown on screen. If the phone count says 2/5, you still need three. As in hidden object games, you scan the room to find objects among everyday belongings. Need another phone? Find it and tap to collect it. Watch the count update as you work through the sorting puzzle.

Check the tray
When you find items from two groups, choose which one to collect first. One more shirt could finish a group. Find it among the clothes if that's what you need. As you find objects in this sorting puzzle, watch the space in your tray. If it's full and you can't add another item, the round ends.

GAME FEATURES

See the room change
Fans of hidden object games can find items among scattered clothes and snacks. One snack bag left on the list? Find it and watch it move when you tap. Find objects for each group and see a tidy room take shape. The sorting puzzle shows your progress one item at a time.

Play a round on a break
If you like casual games, take a moment to turn clutter into a tidy room. Fans of hidden object games can find objects, check the counts, and find items for the remaining groups. Still missing one item? Find it to complete the sorting puzzle. Collect the required amount in every category and enjoy your tidy room.

android:com.game.quack.screw.unriddle.mo.name: Save Duck:Earn Money
android:com.game.quack.screw.unriddle.mo.description:
Save Duck: Earn Money is a casual screw-puzzle game. Each level features a cute duck trapped behind wooden boards fastened with screws. Remove the screws in the right order, let the planks fall, and rescue the duck. Clear levels to earn in-game money and rewards. Simple to play, satisfying to solve, and full of brain-teasing fun!

Full Description:
Save Duck: Earn Money is a relaxing yet challenging puzzle game built around unscrewing and physics-based plank removal. In every level, a duck is stuck behind a set of wooden boards held together by screws. Your job is to tap or drag to unscrew the correct screws, drop the wooden planks, and set the duck free.

Think before you unscrew! Some screws block others, and removing the wrong one may cause planks to shift or get stuck. Plan your moves carefully, clear each puzzle, and earn money as you progress.

Features:

Addictive unscrew puzzle gameplay

Cute ducks waiting to be rescued

Physics-based wooden plank removal

Increasingly tricky levels and screw layouts

Earn in-game money and rewards by clearing stages

Simple controls and casual one-hand play

Satisfying puzzle-solving fun for all ages

How to Play:

Tap or drag to remove screws.

Watch the wooden boards fall.

Free the duck behind the planks.

Complete the level and earn money.

Save the duck. Solve the puzzle. Earn your reward!

ios:6818465459.name: Tank Busters: Cannon Battle
ios:6818465459.description:
TANK BATTLES WHERE EVERYTHING BREAKS

Aim your cannon, choose the perfect angle, and fire! In Tank Busters, every shot can change the battlefield. Blast through walls, bring down towers, destroy bridges, and turn the environment against your opponent.

Jump into fast tank duels across colorful voxel arenas where there’s more than one way to win. Hit the enemy tank directly or use physics to create your own path to victory. Break their cover, open a new firing line, or collapse the structures around them.

AIM, FIRE & OUTSMART YOUR RIVAL

Winning takes more than firepower. Adjust your trajectory, watch the battlefield, and find the smartest shot. The arena changes with every blast, so a safe hiding place can disappear in seconds.

Use destructible environments to your advantage, protect your tank from incoming shells, and look for unexpected ways to reach your opponent. Every duel becomes a mix of precision, physics, and satisfying destruction.

TURN DESTRUCTION INTO STRATEGY

Walls and buildings aren’t just scenery — they’re part of the battle. Punch through obstacles to open up a clear shot, destroy your rival’s cover, or bring entire structures crashing down at just the right moment.

Sometimes the best shot isn’t aimed directly at the enemy. Find the right angle, predict where your shell will land, and use the arena itself as a weapon. As structures fall and paths open up, you’ll need to adapt your strategy with every turn.

MASTER EVERY SHOT

Learn how your cannon behaves and put your aiming skills to the test. Adjust the angle, follow the trajectory, and land clean shots from across the arena.

Each battle gives you a new tactical puzzle to solve. Go for a direct hit when you have a clear line of fire, or get creative when your opponent hides behind cover. One well-placed shell can completely change the fight.

 FAST TANK DUELS, BIG DESTRUCTION

Drop into vibrant voxel arenas built for quick, action-packed battles. Maneuver your tank into position, dodge incoming shells, cross bridges, and tear through the environment as you hunt down your rival.

Simple controls make it easy to start firing, while destructible battlefields and physics-based shots give you plenty of ways to refine your strategy. No two fights unfold exactly the same way when every blast can reshape the arena.

Aim carefully, use the environment, and find your own way to destroy the competition.

Download Tank Busters and let the destruction begin!

android:com.vialmagic.colorsort.description:
Vial Magic: Color Sort is a single-player water sorting puzzle game with a collectible CG illustration gallery. Players solve levels by moving colored liquid between bottles, then progress through the game to unlock pictures for their collection.

WHAT YOU DO IN THE GAME

The main activity is sorting colored water. Each level displays bottles containing several layers of different colors. You must move the liquid between these bottles until every non-empty bottle contains only one color.

The colors remain separate layers. You are organizing them, not mixing them to create new colors.

HOW THE POURING CONTROLS WORK

Tap a bottle to select it, then tap another bottle to pour liquid into it.

A pour is allowed when the destination bottle has enough empty space and either contains no liquid or has the same color on top as the liquid being moved.

Only the uppermost color can be poured. To move a color underneath another layer, you must first remove the liquid above it. You cannot pour into a full bottle or place a color on top of a different color.

Continue moving the layers until the colors are separated into single-color bottles. Bottles that are not needed can remain empty.

EXAMPLE OF A MOVE

If one bottle has blue liquid above red liquid, you must move the blue liquid before you can access the red.

You can pour that blue liquid into an empty bottle or another bottle with blue liquid on top, as long as there is enough room. Removing the blue layer exposes the red layer and creates another possible move.

SOLVING THE LEVELS

Look at the arrangement before choosing a bottle. Empty bottles provide temporary storage and help you reach colors trapped beneath other layers.

A move that matches two colors may still leave you without enough space for the next step. Consider both the color you are moving and the layer that will be exposed afterward.

Completing the sorting objective clears the current level and allows you to continue to the next puzzle.

CG ILLUSTRATION COLLECTION

In addition to the water sorting levels, Vial Magic: Color Sort includes CG artwork, meaning digital illustrations that players can unlock and collect.

Progress through the puzzle levels to meet the game's artwork unlock requirements. Unlocked illustrations become available in the in-game gallery, where you can open and view the pictures you have collected.

The illustrations are collection content, separate from the sorting board. The core gameplay remains moving colored liquid between bottles to solve puzzles.

MAIN FUNCTIONS

Water sorting levels with layered colored liquids.

Tap controls for selecting a source bottle and a destination bottle.

Pouring rules based on matching colors and available bottle space.

Level progression through completed sorting puzzles.

Collectible CG illustrations unlocked through game progress.

An in-game gallery for viewing unlocked artwork.

Vial Magic: Color Sort combines bottle-sorting puzzles with picture collection. Solve the liquid arrangements, advance through the levels, and build your CG illustration collection.

Sheru Bhai Game 3D is an open-world action game where you play as Sheru Bhai: a royal white lion in a white-and-gold suit, full of desi Bhai swagger, and the richest lion in the city. Explore a big island, drive luxury supercars, fly jets and a helicopter, live in your own gold mansion, change your royal look and grow your fame with your phone's photo app.

Your Royal Mansion
• Live in Sheru Bhai's mansion on Royal Hill, with marble floors, gold lion statues, a pool deck and a gold room with a huge pile of gold.
• Walk through every room: the master suite, the office, the guest room and more.
• Doors swing open as you walk through, and the main gate slides open when you arrive on foot or by car.
• Make it rain: throw money with the lion money button.

Your Royal Look
• Open the wardrobe in the master bedroom and pick your style.
• Suits: White Gold, White Classic and Black Premium.
• Specs: gold aviators, black shades or diamond specs.
• On your head: a gold crown, a diamond crown, or a black or white cap.

Supercars, Bikes and Aircraft
• 15 luxury cars, from supercars and hypercars to a big luxury SUV and a formula racing car.
• Two cars in Sheru Bhai's own designs: a white, black and gold lion hypercar and a diamond-and-gold supercar.
• Ride superbikes, and fly fighter jets, a big jet, a propeller plane and a helicopter.
• Call any vehicle from your phone and drive anywhere on the island.
• Visit the luxury car showroom, where a gold racing car turns on its stand.

An Island to Explore
• Roam a big open island: highways and hill roads, an airport, sandy beaches and a beach island, a village, a stadium, a police station and more.
• Day, night, clouds and rain: let the weather change by itself, or pick the one you like in Settings.
• Cause trouble, like blowing up cars, and police cars will come after you.

Your Royal Phone
A gold-and-ivory phone with your own apps:
• Vehicle: call cars, bikes and aircraft.
• Weapon: pick your weapons and change their colours.
• Bank: see Sheru Bhai's royal fortune.
• Camera: take photos and selfies anywhere on the island.

Play Your Way
• Simple touch controls to walk, run, drive and fly.
• Play offline: no internet needed.
• No sign-up and no account.

Live like a king and drive like a legend. Become Sheru Bhai!

android:com.turbo.slope.name: Turbo Slope
android:com.turbo.slope.description:
One push, one long slope and a lot of snow. How far can your sled go?

Every run starts at the top of the hill. You let go, pick up speed on the downhill drop, catch air off the ramps and try to make it over the next crest. Didn't make it? Fine. Take the coins you earned, upgrade your sled and go again. Each run gets you a little further than the last, and that's exactly where this sled game gets you.

WHAT YOU DO
• Slide down steep winter slopes and fly off kickers, humps and snow ramps, a proper ramp jump every time
• Steer through green speed gates and stay away from the red ones that slow you down
• Dodge skiers, rolling snowballs and trees, or jump on the rails for a bit of style
• Upgrade your launch, glide and more to beat the hill that stopped you last time, the way a good upgrade game should work
• Reach the finish line, grab your diamonds and head to a longer, tougher level

PLACES TO RIDE
Start in the mountains with a big first drop and sharp crests that decide everything. Then move on to the Frozen Lakes, wide open ice where you can glide for ages if you bring enough speed. Real physics game feel: every bump, landing and slope changes your run. More spots for fans of winter games are coming.

RIDERS AND SKINS
Open chests to unlock new riders and sled skins. Santa is in there too, so it turns into a little Christmas game whenever you want, all year round.

EASY TO PICK UP
One finger to steer, short runs and progress you can feel after every try. A simple casual game for a quick five minute break, and just as good for a longer evening of "okay, one more run". Old school arcade game vibes, modern snow.

If you like sledding, snow racing, any jump game with big air or a relaxing sliding game where every run counts, Turbo Slope should feel like home. It's a snow game without complicated controls or long tutorials. Just you, the sled and the hill.

See you at the bottom.

android:com.fiogonia.drawshape.name: Paint Shape: Block Puzzle
android:com.fiogonia.drawshape.description:
NO TIMER. NO PRESSURE. JUST DRAW & RELAX.

Draw colorful shapes, follow simple rules and solve satisfying drawing puzzles at your own pace.

Draw, erase and try again - there's no timer. Make a mistake? Simply erase it, redraw your shape and keep going. With no time or move limits, you're free to experiment until you find the solution.

WHY PLAYERS LOVE PAINT LOGIC
- No timer - draw without time pressure
- No move limits - experiment freely
- Relaxing and satisfying drawing gameplay
- Bright colors and clean, minimal visuals
- Easy to learn and play at your own pace
- New rules and mechanics keep levels fresh
- Take part in events and mini-games
- Earn rewards and climb the leaderboards

HOW TO PLAY
- Draw connected shapes on the board
- Follow the rules for each puzzle
- Erase and redraw whenever you need
- Complete all the required shapes to clear the level

Need a little help? Use power-ups to reveal exactly where to draw, or complete a shape for you.

Every board starts simple, with new rules and mechanics adding fresh twists as you progress. Take your time, experiment and enjoy watching each colorful puzzle come together.

No timer. No pressure. Draw, erase and try again.

Download Paint Logic and start drawing!

android:ai.hiyam.app.name: Yam: Dating Sim Games
android:ai.hiyam.app.description:
Live out your relationship fantasy.

Step into a dating show with your favorite cast, star in your own K-drama, or text the one who never texts back.

Walk into the villa as the new bombshell.
Text your campus crush at 2 a.m. — he answers.
Get cast as the lead in your own K-drama.
Three rivals. One gala. Your move.
The contract said no falling in love.

We grew up on fanfic, dating sims and reality TV, and we wanted the version where you are in the story, not watching it. So we built Yam: worlds with a cast who remember you, take sides, get jealous, and text you first.

• Chat with characters who text like real people
• Go on dates, collect photos and build your scrapbook
• Make choices that change who falls for you
• Dress for the moment with your own wardrobe
• Create your own world: tell Yam what you want, then share it with friends

Every world is free to play.

Yam is for adults 18 and over. Characters and their replies are generated by AI and are fictional. You can report any message by pressing and holding it.

android:com.airo.spiderinvasion.name: Spider Invasion: Idle Miner
android:com.airo.spiderinvasion.description:
Unleash a neon spider on worlds made of blocks. Drill, slice and shatter your way through glowing pixel-art pictures, upgrade your weapons, and watch every block light up as it breaks. Calm, satisfying, and your spider keeps earning while you're away.

DRILL THROUGH PIXEL WORLDS
Every level is a pixel-art picture built from blocks: a star, a strawberry, a sleeping cat, a castle and many more. Your spider chews through them block by block. Clear the picture, add it to your collection, and move on to the next level.

BUILD YOUR ARSENAL
Unlock and upgrade spider weapons like Silk Line, Leg Slam, Fang Lunge and Venom Spit. Mix them, level them up, and watch your damage climb from hundreds to trillions.

SKILLS THAT STACK
Equip skills such as Overcharge, Surge, Jackpot and Catalyst to multiply your damage, credits and speed. Find the combo that drills fastest.

MOLT AND COME BACK STRONGER
When progress slows, molt. Shed your run for Molt Points and spend them on permanent weapon upgrades, extra weapon slots and bonus damage. Every molt makes the next run faster.

GEAR UP YOUR SPIDER
Open cocoons to find carapaces, venom glands and legs, from common to legendary. Every piece changes how your spider looks and how hard it hits.

IDLE PROGRESS, ANYTIME
Your spider keeps drilling when you close the game. Come back to offline earnings, and switch on a 2x boost whenever you want to go faster.

MORE TO DO EVERY DAY
Complete tasks, dig through the Mine for rare ore, and climb past your rivals.

FEATURES
• Relaxing idle block-breaking with a clean dark neon look
• Pixel-art worlds to drill through and collect
• Weapons, skills and spider gear to upgrade and combine
• Molt for permanent power and faster runs
• Offline earnings: progress even when you're not playing
• Satisfying effects and calm ASMR sound
• Short sessions or long ones, play at your own pace
• Available in 15 languages

Spider Invasion is free to play. It contains optional in-app purchases and ads.

android:com.kirush.dragon.name: Ki Rush : Dragon Fight
android:com.kirush.dragon.description:
Enter the arena in Ki Rush: Arena Edition, a fast 3D fighting game built around quick duels, dramatic stages, and flexible ways to play.

Choose your fighter, read your opponent, and use movement, timing, and special attacks to control the fight. Play solo in offline-style modes, jump into online battles, or customize the experience to suit your device and play style.

Features

- Fast 3D arena combat with responsive controls
- Online multiplayer duels
- Multiple solo and battle modes
- Customizable touch-control layouts
- Gamepad support
- Graphics and performance options
- Support for texture packs, mods, stages, and music
- Optional Premium upgrade

Play your way

Use the built-in touch controls or connect a compatible controller. Rearrange the on-screen layout, adjust sensitivity, and choose the graphics settings that work best for your device.

android:com.morningwakeup.reel.name: Wake Reel
android:com.morningwakeup.reel.description:
🎰 Spin into a more playful morning

Still hitting snooze? Give the reels a spin and reveal the wake-up task waiting for you. The surprise is part of the fun—you might get a number challenge, an arrow game, quick math, or a memory task.

⏰ Set the alarm your way

Create alarms around your routine, choose when they repeat, and pick your alarm sound and vibration settings. Add a wake-up challenge, then spin to see what you’ll play when it’s time to get up.

🎲 One spin. One task. Time to wake up.

Choose Light, Standard, or Intense. When your alarm rings, complete the selected mini-game to turn it off and get your morning moving.

What will the reels reveal for your next wake-up?

android:com.braingames.luckycasinoadvent.name: Lucky Casino Adventure
android:com.braingames.luckycasinoadvent.description:
Welcome to **Lucky Casino Adventure** — build, manage, and grow your very own casino empire!

Start with a small casino and turn it into a spectacular entertainment destination. Fill your floors with exciting attractions, welcome new guests, hire the right people, and keep the money rolling in as your business grows.

🎰 **BUILD YOUR CASINO EMPIRE**

Create and upgrade your casinos with new machines, attractions, decorations, and facilities. The bigger your casino becomes, the more opportunities you’ll unlock.

💰 **EARN & GROW**

Your casino keeps working as you expand. Collect your earnings, invest them wisely, upgrade your business, and watch your profits climb.

👔 **HIRE & MANAGE STAFF**

A great casino needs a great team! Hire people to help run your growing empire and improve your casino operations.

🎲 **PLAY FUN MINI-GAMES**

Take a break from managing your business and try your luck in entertaining casino-inspired mini-games. Spin, collect rewards, and discover surprises along the way.

🦝 **MEET YOUR LUCKY COMPANION**

Your mischievous raccoon friend is always nearby as you build your fortune, discover new locations, and chase the next big reward.

🏨 **UNLOCK NEW CASINOS**

Your first casino is only the beginning. Progress through the adventure, discover new destinations, and build bigger and more impressive casinos as your empire expands.

⭐ **BECOME A CASINO TYCOON**

Upgrade. Expand. Collect. Repeat.

Can you build the ultimate casino empire?

Download **Lucky Casino Adventure** and start building your fortune today!

Lucky Casino Adventure is a casual casino-themed idle and management game intended for entertainment. It does not offer real-money gambling or the opportunity to win real money or real-world prizes.

android:com.funtaptic.spacerockbreaker.name: Space Rock Breaker
android:com.funtaptic.spacerockbreaker.description:
Turn mined asteroids into your next upgrade in Space Rock Breaker, a short incremental space mining game that combines guns, ore processing and a massive skill tree.

MINE ASTEROIDS AND UNLOCK MATERIALS
Use guns to break apart space rocks and gather ore. Unlock new materials as you progress, with mining at the center of the experience.

PROCESS YOUR HAUL WITH PLINKO
Your collected ore goes into a Plinko machine for processing. This pairing of asteroid mining and Plinko gives your haul another stage before you spend credits on upgrades.

BUILD PROGRESS THROUGH UPGRADES
Put your credits into a large skill tree and choose your next upgrades. The core loop connects mining, ore processing and spending credits, taking you from breaking rocks to unlocking upgrades.

A SHORT INCREMENTAL EXPERIENCE
Space Rock Breaker focuses on a compact mining-and-upgrade experience. Discover its combination of space mining, Plinko processing and skill-tree progression.

Mine. Process. Upgrade.

ios:6743441683.name: Bubble Bus: Parking Jam Puzzle
ios:6743441683.description:
Bubble Bus is a fun and relaxing color sorting game with a twist. Drive buses, park them in the right spots, and collect matching color bubbles. Plan your moves carefully — if the parking lot is full and you miss the right bubbles, the game is over.

This game is more than just sorting colors. Use smart tools like VIP parking and shuffle features to help organize the traffic jam and clear the board. It’s simple to play but gets more challenging as you go.

If you enjoy puzzle games that test your logic and keep your mind sharp, Bubble Bus is the perfect choice.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://www.moonee.io/privacy-policyDownload now and start sorting!

ios:6449094229.name: Match Factory!
ios:6449094229.description:
Welcome to Match Factory - The Ultimate 3D Puzzle Adventure!

Dive into the fascinating world of Match Factory, the brand new puzzle game from the creators of Toon Blast & Toy Blast. Once you play, you will come for Match Factory every day!

Connect identical items, sort tiles, and clear the board in this mesmerizing match 3D game. Challenge your puzzle-solving skills as you keep sorting and matching objects until every item is cleared from the screen. It’s not just a puzzle; it’s a test of your wit and strategy.

Relax and Have Fun! Leave your worries behind and enjoy quality relaxation and fun. Immerse yourself in the soothing game atmosphere , enjoy your brain time and increase your zen!

Play Anytime, Anywhere without WI-FI! Enjoy the game online or offline, and never worry about Wi-Fi. Whether you’re on a grand adventure or simply taking a break, Match Factory will always be there to entertain you. In-app purchases do require an active internet connection.

Become the Master of 3D Puzzles! Time is of the essence in this match 3d game! With each level equipped with a timer, you’ll need to think fast and act even faster to triumph!

Boosters to the Rescue! Stuck on a level? Fear not! Match Factory offers a range of powerful boosters to help you overcome tricky situations. Utilize these remarkable tools to advance through the game and unlock exciting items like fruits, candy, cake objects and much more!

Immerse yourself in the world of Match Factory, where thrilling 3D puzzles and hidden objects awaits your keen eye and sharp mind! Download Match Factory now and prove your matching skills to the world! Can you conquer every level and emerge as the ultimate puzzle master?

The Factory Gates Are Open - Start Matching Now!

Match Factory is free to download and includes optional in-game purchases. If you wish to disable in-game purchases, please turn off the in-app purchases in your phone or tablet’s Settings.

You must be at least 13 years of age, or such higher age as required in your country, to play or download Match Factory.

android:bus.traffic.fever.jam.puzzle.bus.name: Bus Go:Traffic Puzzle
android:bus.traffic.fever.jam.puzzle.bus.description:
Take control of the city streets in Bus Go: Traffic Puzzle, the ultimate bus traffic puzzle game! Plan your moves, slide buses, and clear congested roads to guide passengers safely to their destinations. With hundreds of fun and challenging levels, this game is perfect for puzzle lovers of all ages!
Game Features:
  Exciting traffic puzzles – Move buses and cars strategically to solve each level. 
  Hundreds of levels – From easy beginner challenges to tricky brain-teasers. 
  Vibrant city streets – Enjoy colorful graphics and lively traffic scenarios. 
  Rewards and achievements – Unlock new levels, earn stars, and improve your score. 
  Brain training fun – Enhance logic, problem-solving, and spatial skills while playing. 
  Quick gameplay sessions – Perfect for short bursts or longer strategy challenges. 
Slide, plan, and conquer the traffic! Download Bus Go: Traffic Puzzle now and start your journey as the city’s ultimate bus master!

android:com.fc.electronic.repair.shop.si.name: Cozy Repair
android:com.fc.electronic.repair.shop.si.description:
Got a pile of broken gadgets and a workbench waiting? Cozy Repair turns you into the repair technician of a cozy workshop. Open up radios, consoles and home appliances, find what is wrong and bring each one back to life.

HOW TO PLAY
Pick a broken device from the customer queue. Unscrew the case and clean away dust and grime. Find the faulty part, then swap, solder or reconnect it. Close it up, test it and hand it back to a happy owner.

WHY YOU WILL LOVE IT
- Satisfying repair simulator: every step of fixing electronics feels hands-on.
- Relaxing ASMR sounds: screws, clicks, sparks and soft cleaning.
- Many devices to restore: from old phones to retro TVs and appliances.
- Before and after: watch rusty, dusty gadgets turn like new.
- Upgrade your workshop: unlock better tools and bigger jobs.
- Easy one-touch controls, play at your own pace.

Whether you love repair games, restoration videos or simply a calm simulation to unwind, Cozy Repair gives you one more device to fix.

android:com.cash.number.wheel.money.name: Cash Bingo Spin: Earn Money
android:com.cash.number.wheel.money.description:
Cash Bingo Spin: Earn Money is a money themed clicker game inspired by classic bingo and lucky spinning wheel gameplay. Tap the screen to spin the bingo wheel and enjoy the repeated actions as the lucky wheel stops to reveal winning numbers. Enter a vibrant bingo world filled with colorful wheel graphics, exciting animations, and a cash focused gameplay experience. Every tap keeps the spinning action going, creating a simple and satisfying rhythm as you follow the game's money themed progression. With straightforward controls and familiar bingo atmosphere, the game combines classic tapping mechanics with the fun of lucky number matching. Cash, earnings, income, profit, balance, and rewards are central themes throughout the experience, bringing a fortune inspired feel to every wheel spin. No recharge required. Real withdrawal supported. Tap to spin the bingo wheel, enjoy the thrilling lucky draw atmosphere, and follow your earning progress in a clicker game built around simple interactions and cash themed fun.

android:com.playgogames.fish.name: Where Fish Fly
android:com.playgogames.fish.description:
"Nothing special will ever happen in my life. Reality is painfully predictable."

A high school girl who never bought into fantasy enrolls in a quiet boarding school, hoping for a calm, ordinary life. But before she can even settle in, strange rumors begin to reach her.

She scoffs at every story, while her roommates' eyes sparkle with curiosity. The world can't possibly be that interesting. Determined to prove it, she sets out to uncover the truth herself.

◆ A cozy mystery where no one dies
No crime scenes, no culprits. The stage is a classroom and a dorm, and the clues are passing remarks and small oddities. This is a mystery about the riddles hidden in everyday life.

◆ You are the detective
Combine the clues you gather to form a hypothesis. Back it up with evidence, and it grows into a deduction. As your reasoning progresses, you can see the answer drawing closer on screen, so you always feel that satisfying sense of getting there.

◆ Gather by day, deduce by night
Explore the campus, talk to students, and observe carefully during the day. At night, gather in the dorm room for deduction time with your roommates. Four girls with very different personalities and interests untangle each mystery from their own angles.

◆ Recommended for you if
· You enjoy everyday mysteries with no crime scenes or culprits
· You love the quiet atmosphere of slice-of-life school stories
· You want to deduce with your own head, not just read along

Fish don't fly. So she believed. Her story begins here.

android:com.arrowescape.mania.name: Arrow Escape Mania
android:com.arrowescape.mania.description:
Every arrow needs a way out. Can you find the right order?

Arrow Escape Mania is a logic puzzle game where a single tap can open up new possibilities. Examine the board, follow each arrow’s direction, and remove the arrows with a clear path. Keep untangling the layout until the board is empty!

HOW TO PLAY
• Look at the direction each arrow points.
• Find an arrow that can move out without being blocked.
• Tap to send it off the board.
• Use the space you create to free the remaining arrows.

SIMPLE TAPS, CLEVER SOLUTIONS
Getting started is easy, but clearing a crowded board takes observation and planning. An arrow that blocks your way now could be the key to your next move. Study the connections and decide which path to open first.

UNTANGLE EACH BOARD
Work through different arrow arrangements and discover how each move changes the puzzle. Look for openings around the edges, trace blocked paths, and turn a tangled layout into a clear board.

FIND YOUR PUZZLE FLOW
Enjoy the satisfaction of watching arrows slide away as your plan comes together. Take a closer look, think a few moves ahead, and discover the solution one tap at a time.

FEATURES
• Easy-to-learn tap controls
• Direction-based logic puzzles
• Varied arrow layouts to untangle
• Gameplay built around observation and move order
• Satisfying board-clearing moments

Ready to make your escape? Download Arrow Escape Mania and find a way out for every arrow!

android:com.rongyee.color.cozypainting.name: Cozy Painting: Coloring Book
android:com.rongyee.color.cozypainting.description:
Bring Color to the Little Joys of Everyday Life!

Welcome to Cozy Painting: Coloring Book, a relaxing color-by-number game filled with beautiful illustrations inspired by everyday life. From cozy homes and charming interiors to peaceful landscapes, cute animals, and lovely flowers, there’s always something wonderful to color.

Simply follow the numbers, fill each area with the matching colors, and watch every picture come to life. No drawing skills are needed — just choose a picture you love and enjoy coloring at your own pace.

🎨 Explore a Variety of Beautiful Themes

🏡 Houses & Interiors
Discover cozy homes, charming rooms, beautiful decorations, and inviting living spaces.

🌄 Landscapes & Scenery
Color peaceful countryside views, beautiful natural landscapes, and charming places.

🌸 Flowers & Nature
Bring lovely flowers, green plants, and the beauty of nature to life.

🐾 Animals & Pets
Enjoy adorable animals, sweet pets, and heartwarming illustrations.

🧍 People & Daily Life
Explore everyday moments, familiar activities, and scenes full of life.

🍰 Food & Drinks
Color delicious dishes, sweet treats, and delightful food illustrations.

🪴 Still Life & Everyday Objects
Discover beautiful arrangements and the little details that make ordinary things special.

🚗 Vehicles & Transportation
Explore cars and other vehicles through a variety of illustrations.

🙏 Faith & Inspiration
Discover meaningful faith-inspired themes and illustrations.

🌿 Enjoy Coloring Every Day

Easy Color-by-Number Gameplay: Follow the numbers and fill each area with the right color.

Daily Pictures: Find pictures to enjoy every day.

A Relaxing Experience: Take a break, slow down, and color at your own pace.

💛 Make Every Day a Little Cozier

Whether you love cozy interiors, beautiful scenery, cute animals, colorful flowers, or everyday moments, Cozy Painting has something for you. Take a little time for yourself, enjoy the coloring process, and bring more color to your day.
