android:com.tripledot.blockflow.name: Smash Party! - 3D Puzzle
android:com.tripledot.blockflow.description:
Welcome to the biggest little smash party!

Aim your cannon, line up the perfect shot, and turn colorful stacks into a celebration of flying cans, tumbling hay bales, and shattering jam jars. Every hit can set off a satisfying chain reaction and bring the whole structure crashing down.

Each level is a playful 3D physics puzzle. Look for the weak spot, choose your target, and send a party ball into the stack. One well-placed shot can start a spectacular collapse, while trickier levels call for careful aim and smart puzzle solving.

Keep the party rolling with different cannon modes, including Big Ball and Machine Gun. Smash through clever structures, watch objects bounce and tumble, and enjoy the surprise of every physics-driven chain reaction.

Step into a bright backyard celebration filled with balloons, bunting, presents, and playful party colors. With simple aim-and-shoot controls and quick levels, Smash Party! is easy to pick up and full of satisfying shots to master.

GAME FEATURES

- Aim, shoot, and smash with colorful cannons
- Satisfying physics-based destruction and chain reactions
- Clever 3D puzzle levels and stacks to knock down
- Cans, jam jars, hay bales, and more to smash
- Big Ball and Machine Gun cannon modes
- Bright party scenery with balloons and bunting
- Simple controls with rewarding precision shots
- Playful animations and colorful 3D visuals
- Quick levels for a little celebration anytime

The cannon is loaded, the targets are stacked, and the party is ready.

Take aim and let the good times tumble in Smash Party!

android:com.sand.art5.flow.sea.name: Sand Art Flow
android:com.sand.art5.flow.sea.description:
Let the colors flow in Sand Art Flow!

Discover a satisfying blend of sand sorting and pixel art puzzles. Guide colorful buckets along the conveyor belt, match the right colors, and watch charming pictures come to life, one section at a time.

🪣 TAP, SORT & FILL
Pick your next bucket and send it onto the conveyor. Match the colorful sand to the right spaces and enjoy watching each part of the picture fill with color.

🧠 PLAN YOUR NEXT MOVE
Study the layout and choose your bucket order carefully. As new challenges appear, a thoughtful move can help you clear the way and bring your artwork closer to completion.

✨ GET A LITTLE HELP
A tricky puzzle slowing you down? Use handy boosters to move forward and keep the colors flowing.

🖼️ DISCOVER CHARMING PIXEL ART
Complete levels to reveal delightful pixel designs, from cute animals to colorful scenery. Every finished puzzle adds another creation to your growing collection.

🌈 ENJOY A COLORFUL BREAK
Bright colors, flowing sand, and satisfying reveals turn each puzzle into a cheerful little escape. Take your time and enjoy the transformation as scattered colors become a finished picture.

Whether you have a few spare minutes or time for a longer puzzle session, there’s another colorful creation waiting for you.

Pick a bucket, find your flow, and bring your next masterpiece to life in Sand Art Flow—with the chance to earn a cash reward!

android:com.fidgettradingdumplingcardsga.name: Dirt Town: Road Builder 3D
android:com.fidgettradingdumplingcardsga.description:
Welcome to Dirt Works: Road Builder, an exciting construction simulator where you transform rough terrain into incredible roads and racing tracks!

Take control of powerful construction machines, push dirt, cut down trees, move rocks, and transport gravel to complete challenging construction tasks. Explore an interactive world with physics-based gameplay and build your own construction empire.

Dig deep pits to collect resources, clear obstacles, and create smooth roads across challenging landscapes. Earn money by completing tasks and unlock new heavy machines to expand your construction capabilities.

Game Features:

Physics-based dirt and terrain simulation

Powerful construction vehicles and heavy machinery

Road building and excavation challenges

Tree cutting and rock-moving activities

Gravel transportation and resource collection

Dirt bike racing track construction

Machine unlocking and progression

Interactive construction environments

Start your construction adventure, operate heavy machinery, and transform an empty landscape into your ultimate dirt construction town!

android:com.SecretModeLimited.Everything.name: Everything is Crab
android:com.SecretModeLimited.Everything.description:
Set in a living ecosystem, 'Everything is Crab' is a cute, challenging, highly replayable action roguelite. Make animal inspired evolutionary choices to concoct your own unique creature every run, both mechanically and visually.

BEAT CARCINIZATION
As everybody knows, eventually, every organism ends up evolving into a crab. Right?
Well, except for you. Choose your own evolutionary path and strategy to thrive and defeat convergent evolution. Take that, science!

EVOLVE. ADAPT. OVERCOME
Over 160 abilities combine to create a plethora of different builds and playstyles: Become a wily trickster, a ferocious predator, a gregarious leader, a nimble nomad, or take on any number of other survival strategies.
Legs! Claws! Pincers! Wings! More Legs! Fur! Tail! Scales! Tentacles! I SAID MORE LEGS!!! 
Build your formidable, visually awkward chimera or get Darwin'd in the process.

160+ evolution based abilities
Endless possibilities and visual combinations
Strategy-defining evolutions
Many viable survival strategies and playstyles

A living, thriving ecosystem
Many different critters with their own goals and strategies, each of them with several stages of evolution
Four distinct biomes with different rules, climate events, points of interest, flora and fauna
Night and day cycle

A variety of bosses that may (or may not) appear with each run

Huge meta-progression layer
Difficulties system (if you dare!)
Genetics (starting characters), which can be combined to create endless starting character combinations
Challenge Scenarios (Ice Age, Always Night, Hunted...), to push your adaptation skills to the limit

Endless runs
Prove your survival skills to unlock Endless runs, ditch the timer, and outlast the apocalypse!

Track your findings, meta-progression and achievements in the Codex

ios:6824960905.name: Panzerkeil
ios:6824960905.description:
Panzerkeil is a turn-based hex wargame of the Second World War, built for the phone in your hand and the iPad on your desk. Build an army of your own and lead it through the war.

FREE TO START
The opening battles of each campaign, Basic Training, the Daily Operation and Battle Mode against other players are free. One purchase, The Whole War, unlocks every battle on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV, shared with your family. No ads, no subscriptions.

CHOOSE YOUR SIDE
Lead a German army from Poland to Berlin, the British and Americans from Dunkirk to the Elbe, or the Red Army from the frontier in 1941 to the Reichstag: 48 battles on hand-drawn operational maps. How you win decides where the war goes next: a decisive victory opens a different road, a defeat a harder one. Each battle has a voiced briefing, and afterwards a voiced "What really happened" to set your war beside the real one.

AN ARMY THAT REMEMBERS
Your units travel with you from battle to battle. Name them, paint them, and watch them grow from Green to Guards. They win medals with lasting bonuses, from the Iron Cross to the Victoria Cross, and earn traits from what they live through: Tank Hunters, Street Fighters, Winter-Hardened, or Shell-Shocked and Battle-Weary. Every unit keeps a service record; the fallen go on the Roll of Honour. Win a campaign and your army marches in a victory parade.

BATTLE MODE
Raise a Battle Group for each side of the war, from any unit of the war, and take it into matches against other players. Your army always comes back, keeps what it learned, and earns titles, feats and honours. Choose your side and the weather, fight under fog of war, buy intelligence, and ask for a rematch.

MORALE AND THE FATE OF A UNIT
Units have morale: a surprise against the odds can shake a whole line. Trapped units starve and surrender, and closing a ring is a moment to remember. When a veteran's life hangs on one blow, the battle slows to watch; some cheat death, and a kill against long odds is celebrated as a Long Shot.

SUPPLY, SIEGES AND WEATHER
Supply runs along the roads and railheads you hold. Cut the enemy's lines and their units starve; surround a city and its defences crumble. Snow, mud and storms change how every kind of unit moves and fights, with a three-turn forecast.

BECOME THE COMMANDER
Rise from Major to Field Marshal over 20 levels. Attributes strengthen the whole army; Command Points buy 13 tactics, from an artillery barrage to an airlift. While the game is closed your commander studies the Field Manual or trains a unit of your Battle Group.

EVERY ATTACK SHOWS ITS MATHS
Before you commit, the forecast shows attack and defence, every modifier and the losses each side can expect. Watch the enemy's turn play out, with your general on the radio calling the big moments.

DAILY AND WEEKLY OPERATIONS
A new battle every day and every week, each with its own twist and a leaderboard showing the difficulty every score was earned on. Watch the leader's battle film, and share a film of your own.

FEATURES
• Three campaigns, 48 battles, branching roads through the war
• 126 illustrated unit types, from cavalry to jet fighters
• Battle Mode: your own army against other players, under fog of war
• Turn-based matches through Game Center, with chat and rematches
• Morale, 12 traits, nine medals, service records and the Roll of Honour
• Encirclement, supply lines, sieges, airlifts and weather by unit type
• Voiced briefings, histories and battlefield calls
• Training lessons, and How to Play with diagrams
• Battle films to watch and share
• Three difficulty levels, fog of war, Dynamic Type and colour-vision settings
• 25 Game Center achievements and six leaderboards
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Battles play offline. No ads, no tracking.

ios:6760241229.name: Parallax: Netrek
ios:6760241229.description:
Parallax is a new way to play Netrek, the team space battle game that started on the Internet in 1989. Four teams fight for a galaxy of 40 planets: fly a ship, win dogfights, carry armies and take planets for your team.

LEARN IT HERE
Netrek has a reputation for being hard to learn. Parallax teaches it step by step. The tutorial walks you through your first flight with prompts for the device in your hands, then 15 training missions take you from orbiting your first planet to defending a starbase in a last stand.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Tutorial: learn the controls, then take your first flight.
• 15 missions: from first flight to last stand, with stars for flying well.
• Skirmish: a battle against robots that lasts as long as you like, with your choice of team, ship and difficulty.
• Play online: live games against people on the public Netrek servers, with the classic rules.

MADE FOR APPLE TV, IPAD AND MAC
• Fly with a game controller on every device. On Apple TV a controller is required.
• On iPad, play with on-screen controls or a controller.
• On Mac, use the keyboard and mouse or a controller. The Galactic Map and messages can open in their own windows.
• A quick menu on the controller puts lock, tractor beam and more under one button.

CLASSIC NETREK
Parallax speaks the classic protocol and plays on the same public servers as every other Netrek client, so you join the existing community. Six ship classes, the classic weapons (torpedoes, lasers and plasma) and the classic timings.

GAME CENTER
13 achievements to earn and two leaderboards.

Multiplayer is free to play, always. The tutorial and the first missions are free too. The Advanced and Expert missions are a one-time in-app purchase.

Parallax's protocol and networking code is open source.

ios:6812650477.name: AQUARIUM PULU
ios:6812650477.description:
Talk with PULU
and collect all kinds of PULU

◆How to Play
1 Talk with PULU
2 Give items to PULU
3 Watch PULU grow

Life with PULU, who lives in your aquarium.

Teach PULU words
and give it items.
As you spend time together,
PULU will grow little by little.

When PULU is fully grown,
its color and personality
will clearly show.

What kind of PULU will yours become?
You'll find out once it's grown.

PULU is reborn
again and again, journeying on.
Why not sit back and watch PULU grow at your own pace?

ios:6826184123.name: Astrarium: Bullet Hell Shooter
ios:6826184123.description:
Astrarium is a bullet hell space shooter you play with one thumb. You fly 100 levels through a night sky built like a great brass clock, take on 34 bosses, and turn the enemy's bullets into gold.

No energy, no waiting, no loot boxes, and nothing to buy that makes you stronger.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Drag to fly. Your ship flies above your thumb and moves further than your thumb does, so a short move takes it far. It fires by itself.
• Only the small bright core of your ship can be hit. Let bullets pass close: every one that crosses the gold ring around the core charges your Overdrive, your special attack.
• Fire the Overdrive and every bullet on the screen turns into gold.
• Lift your thumb and time stands still. Find the gap, then fly on.

100 LEVELS, 34 BOSSES
• 16 skies, each with its own enemies, its own music and its own tricks: darkness lit only by lanterns, curtains of sand with one wandering gap, meteors whose shadows show where they will fall.
• Every third level, a constellation boss of brass and pearls: Scorpius, Draco, Leo, Hercules, Gemini and more. Some are mazes of turning wheels and running chains that you fly through, because no shot can break them.
• At level 100 waits the Astrarium itself, the hardest fight in the game.

UPGRADES YOU PICK
After each level you pick one of three upgrades. 54 upgrades in six kinds change how you shoot, dodge, collect and survive, and three or five of one kind unlock bonus powers. Every 12 levels your upgrades start over, and you keep one of them for the rest of the game.

SIX SHIPS
Polaris, balanced. Vega, a wide fan of shots. Antares, slow and heavy. Sirius, with wings that hunt on their own. Altair, small and quick. Deneb, strongest up close. Unlock them with Starlight, the reward you earn in every level.

THE SUPERNOVA
Everything your Overdrive destroys lights one of eight lights around your ship. When all eight are lit, tap the power button and a ring of light sweeps across the whole screen. Or save it, and it blocks the next hit for you.

FROM RELAXED TO NEARLY IMPOSSIBLE
The first skies are for everyone. Then every 12 levels bring something new, and the last ten levels are made for shoot 'em up veterans: nearly impossible. Lose a level and you fly it again right there, with more shields every time. Want more time to react? Switch on the gentler pace.

MUSIC THAT PLAYS ALONG
Every sky has its own theme, sung by a choir. The music grows with your combo, and every piece of gold you collect plays a note in the key of the song.

FAIR BY DESIGN
• The whole game is free to play.
• Ads only when you choose to watch one for a reward, never during a level. For example: after a lost level, one ad gives you two shields so you can keep going.
• One optional purchase, Patron, to support us: you get every reward without watching an ad, plus a special aurora trail behind your ship.
• Plays offline.

ALSO
• Daily Flight: one short challenge a day, the same for everybody
• Over 50 small goals to earn
• Three bullet colours chosen with colour blindness in mind, a calm screen option (fewer flashes, no shaking) and automatic Overdrive
• Portrait, one hand, playable on a bus
• English and German

ios:6834231907.name: Cats by Post
ios:6834231907.description:
The parcels are purring. Best get them home.

Cats by Post is a cosy logic puzzle game about cats in boxes. Place turntables, work out a route and send the post. Your job is to get every cat to the right basket. Their job is to curl up in it.

Start with a few simple deliveries in the Sorting Office, then follow the post through a busy depot, aboard the mail train and into the Great Postal Vault. Gates change direction, paired tunnels open up new routes, and bigger cats take things at their own pace. That neat little plan might need another look.

There’s plenty to keep the sorting desk busy:
- 100 puzzles, with new twists as your postal round grows.
- Today’s Post: a fresh puzzle every day.
- Practice puzzles and Night Shift for when you fancy another delivery.
- Cat photographs to collect as you bring more cats home in Night Shift.
- Detailed paper-cutout rooms, small things to notice and music to keep you company.
Take your time over a tricky route. Try another arrangement. Then enjoy the moment when the last cat settles into its basket.

Precious cargo. Handle with care.

ios:6828917582.name: Chibiwish
ios:6828917582.description:
Meet Star: a tiny chibi girl with a cozy little room, a big appetite and a closet full of cute outfits.
Pat her, dress her up, cook her favorite dishes, dance together and fill your Wish Album, a few happy minutes at a time.
Every week brings a new costume board, with free spins you earn just by playing.

• DRESS HER UP
Open her closet and pick today's look. Collect outfits and find her new favorite dress.

• A NEW COSTUME EVERY WEEK
Each week a new themed board opens with a costume to win. Spins are free: you get one every day, earn more by caring for Star, or watch an optional video for extra spins. Spins are never sold, and the board shows the odds of every prize before you spin.

• COOK HER CRAVINGS
Star gets hungry just like you. When her tummy rumbles, she tells you which dish she is craving. Pick a recipe, let it cook and serve it warm. Learn new recipes as you go.

• FILL YOUR WISH ALBUM
Collect illustrated cards, chapter by chapter. Every card is earned by playing: finish daily goals and play the weekly board to open chests of cards, coins and gems. Cards are never sold.

• DANCE TOGETHER
Step into the dance room, pick a difficulty and tap in time with Star's moves.

• GO TO SCHOOL
Put on her school uniform and join a lesson at the chalkboard. Match the pairs and finish class with a smile.

• BUBBLY BATH TIME
When Star needs a wash, run her a bath and scrub her clean until she sparkles.

• MAKE HER ROOM YOURS
• Place furniture, rugs, plushies and lamps wherever you like
• Make over the walls and floors: pick a pattern, then a color
• Change the curtains and brighten up the kitchen

• WEATHER OUTSIDE HER WINDOW
Sunny days, falling leaves, snow and stormy nights. Her room shifts softly from morning light to bedtime.

• LITTLE WISHES, BIG FRIENDSHIP
Each day Star makes a few small wishes. Grant them, keep her happy and grow your friendship to unlock outfits and surprises.

• MADE FOR COZY BREAKS
Visit for a minute or stay a while. Nothing is lost while you are away. She is simply happy you came back.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Chibiwish is free to play. The game shows ads, including optional videos you can watch for a small reward.
- In-app purchases include gem packs, a one-time "Rewards without ads" unlock, and Star Club, a monthly subscription with most rewards without the video and gems every day. Star Club renews automatically until you cancel it in your Apple account settings.
- An internet connection is needed to play.
- Your game is saved on your phone and can be backed up to your own iCloud.
- Plays in English, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

Terms of Use: https://ravideliyahu.com/chibiwish/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://ravideliyahu.com/chibiwish/privacy/

ios:6833364548.name: Don't Touch the Water Game
ios:6833364548.description:
A flooded kingdom. A missing princess. One very dangerous place to swim.

Leap between islands, explore branching paths, and find your way to safety in Don't Touch the Water. The water monster listens for every splash. On land, other creatures stand between you and your escape.

CHOOSE YOUR HERO
Find a character that fits your style, with different strengths and abilities.

MAKE EVERY JUMP COUNT
Cross moving platforms, reach checkpoints, and escape sinking ground before it disappears beneath your feet.

FIGHT FOR YOUR WAY OUT
Collect weapons, take on island monsters, and earn coins to unlock more characters.

FIND THE EXIT
Explore the islands, look for a key, and open the tunnel to safety.

ios:6831523333.name: Dots and Boxes: LAST BOX
ios:6831523333.description: One line can flip the whole board. Connect two dots, claim a square, and take another turn. Think one move ahead… or three. Take on three levels of AI, pass the same iPhone to a friend, or crack 15 free challenges. Send someone a code and see if they spot the move. The optional Extra Notebook adds 15 tougher puzzles and three paper styles. Play offline.

ios:6831673520.name: NPL Cricket League
ios:6831673520.description:
NPL Cricket League is online cricket made in Nepal. Make a lobby, bring your friends or let anyone join, and play a real match ball by ball.

PLAY ONLINE, YOUR WAY
• Blitz (2 overs) or Quick (5 overs) matches.
• Teams of 1 to 11 players a side.
• Private lobbies for a code or an invite, friends-only lobbies, or open lobbies anyone can join.
• Quick Join drops you into an open lobby with room, or browse the lobbies that are waiting.
• Captains call the toss, choose to bat or bowl and set the batting order.

BAT AND BOWL
• Time your shots and pick your gaps: leg side, off side or lofted.
• Bowl pace or swing, and drag on the pitch to choose your line and length.
• Every ball is decided on the server, so both sides see the same match.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• Add friends by username and see who is online.
• Invite friends straight into your lobby, with a notification if they are away.
• Quick chat, short messages, emotes and voice calls ("Run! Run!", "Howzat!", "What a shot!").

YOUR GAME, YOUR LANGUAGE
• Play in English or Nepali, with commentary in both.
• Pick your username, one of 12 avatars and your team.

FEEL THE STADIUM
• A full crowd in the stands that builds as the bowler runs in and roars for a six.
• Music, sound effects and player calls each have their own switch in Settings.
• A TV-style camera, and a graphics setting for older phones.

PRACTISE OFFLINE
• A full short match against Lumi AI, our computer opponent: you bowl, then you chase. No account and no internet needed.

SAFE AND FAIR
• Chat is filtered for abuse and is not saved.
• Mute, block or report any player from the lobby. A person reviews every report.
• Accounts that break the rules can be suspended or closed.
• No advertising. We never sell your data.
• Delete your account in the game at any time.

Sign in with your email and a one-time code: no password to remember.

NPL Cricket League is made by Lacspace Corporation Private Limited, a software company registered in Nepal. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to the Cricket Association of Nepal (CAN) or the Nepal Premier League.

Privacy: nplcricket.app/privacy
Terms: nplcricket.app/terms
Help: info@lacspace.com

ios:6836077594.name: Oakwarden
ios:6836077594.description:
A golden acorn has been stolen. An ancient darkness has returned. And the forest’s newest guardian must begin his journey before his training is complete.
Step into the autumnal world of Oakwarden: The Long Autumn, a story-driven action adventure filled with enchanted forests, mysterious creatures, forgotten legends, and unlikely heroes.
For centuries, the Oakwardens protected the Golden Acorn and the magic of the Great Oak Tree. But after generations of peace, the guardians disbanded—and the Sentinels quietly returned.
Now, as a young badger Oakwarden, you must take up your staff and follow the trail of the missing acorn. Explore a beautiful storybook realm, battle strange woodland enemies, meet a memorable cast of critters, and uncover the truth behind the darkness spreading across the land.
YOUR JOURNEY AWAITS
• Explore a richly illustrated woodland world Travel through golden forests, rabbit cities, murky swamps, bustling lakeside settlements, haunted mountain roads, ancient mines, and fiery volcanic caverns.
• Face the returning Sentinels Battle acorn warriors, forest ghouls, corrupted creatures, and enormous enemies born from an ancient evil.
• Discover secrets along the trail Leave the main path to find hidden areas, forgotten Oakwardens, optional challenges, and pieces of the realm’s history.
• Play through a cinematic story Experience a heartfelt adventure about becoming the guardian others need you to be.
The Great Oak is beginning to wither, and every shadow in the realm is growing darker.
Take up your staff, young Oakwarden.
Your training ends here.
Your journey begins now.

ios:6817645832.name: 三國幻想錄:開局送5星關羽
ios:6817645832.publisher: Guangzhou Neon Information Technology Co., Ltd
ios:6817645832.description:
黃巾亂起，朝野動盪，大漢江山分崩離析。天下豪雄趁勢而起，諸侯割據四方，戰火蔓延城郭鄉野。梟雄懷吞併天下之志，義士抱匡扶社稷之心，無數武將謀臣登場，譜寫一段段可歌可泣的亂世傳奇。在這風雲變幻的時代，你將作為一方勢力的掌權者，招攬四海豪傑，籌劃軍策，征戰四方，書寫屬於你的三國霸業。

離線掛機躺收資源，告別爆肝刷本；抽中新武將即可直接上陣，無需耗費資源重複培養。打破品質束縛，所有武將皆可突破至無雙境界，無論蓋世名將，或是冷門文臣武吏，只要是你心儀的角色，都能成為隊伍核心主 C。

【幻想亂世・群賢匯聚】
百餘位三國武將經過全新美術演繹，魏、蜀、吳、羣四方豪傑盡數登場。於酒館邂逅各路名將，解鎖武將專屬傳記，窺見英雄背後不為人知的故事，沉浸式感受波瀾壯闊的漢末風雲。

【離線放置，輕鬆征伐天下】
主線闖關全自動戰鬥，離線掛機持續產出金幣、裝備、各類養成素材。上線一鍵領取全部累積收益，利用碎片化時間就能實力進階。閒暇之餘掛機養成，空閒時間調整隊伍陣容，無需耗費大量時間反覆刷關。

【策略佈陣，自由搭配陣容】
不局限傳統強力國家隊，高自由度陣容隨意組合。武將羈絆連攜、神兵秘寶、戰魂加持、站位博弈，不存在一套通吃全關卡的萬能隊伍。依據敵方陣容靈活調整武將，無損切換隊員，巧謀克敵，以智謀決勝沙場。

【多元玩法，飽覽三國風華】
闖關試煉、秘境探險、跨服演武、群雄擂台、軍團混戰等豐富內容。PVE 闖關尋覓絕世寶物，PVP 與全服玩家同台角逐；加入軍團與盟友同心協力攻伐城池，豐厚獎勵全軍團成員皆可共享。

【良心養成，拒絕無謂內卷】
武將裝備、等級、星階一鍵轉移，培養錯武將也不用從頭再來。低品質武將同樣可以培養至畢業強度，零氪、微氪玩家也能搭建心儀的強力隊伍。隨心組建你的幻想三國軍團，縱橫中原，成就亂世霸業。

ios:6838620069.name: Yutnori ABORRO
ios:6838620069.description:
Every throw brings a new possibility.
ABORRO Yutnori brings the classic board game to your iPhone with AI opponents, online multiplayer, and a board designed for thoughtful play.

Throw the sticks, move your pieces, and race to bring all four pieces home. Choose which piece to move, stack your pieces to advance together, capture opponents, and take shortcuts when the opportunity arises.

CHALLENGE AI
Choose from three difficulty levels. Learn the basics, explore different strategies, and challenge yourself as your confidence grows.

PLAY ONLINE
Create a room or join another player's room. Once everyone is ready, start the match. Piece positions, turns, throw results, and match results stay synchronized between players.

MAKE EVERY MOVE COUNT
Stack friendly pieces and move them together. Capture an opponent's pieces to send them back to the start. Plan around extra throws, branching paths, and the result that moves a piece one space backward.

REVIEW YOUR MATCHES
Step through the game record to revisit earlier moves. Look back at captures, route choices, and turning points before starting your next match.

A DISTINCTIVE BOARD
Enjoy a warm gold board, deep green backgrounds, and clearly marked pieces. Open the rules from the home screen whenever you want to review how to play.

FIVE LANGUAGE OPTIONS
Choose from five interface languages in the app's settings.

GETTING STARTED
Guest mode is available for AI matches and online rooms.
An internet connection is required for both AI gameplay and online multiplayer.

Your next match starts with a throw. Play ABORRO Yutnori.

ios:6821648220.name: SHARDFALL: Command RTS
ios:6821648220.description:
SHARDFALL is a real-time strategy game in the tradition of the classic base-building RTS games, made for touch screens. Raise power plants, build a refinery, harvest Shard crystals, train an army and crush your enemy. Play in portrait or landscape.

In 2041 a meteor shower rains crystalline Shard across the world, an energy source that makes whoever harvests it rich beyond measure. Two factions fight for it: the disciplined AEGIS COALITION with heavy armor and air power, and THE VEIL, a technocult built on stealth, fire and artillery.

FEATURES
• A real base-building RTS: power grid, radar, tech tiers, superweapons, engineers and veteran units.
• Built for touch: build bar and commands within thumb reach, in portrait and landscape.
• Two campaigns: 8 missions per faction, telling the same war from both sides.
• Skirmish against the AI on handmade and generated maps, with several difficulty levels. Campaign and skirmish work fully offline and are free.
• Online play: rated 1 vs 1 and 2 vs 2 with fair skill-based matchmaking, friendly matches, replays.
• Friends, groups of up to 4 players, chat, clans and leagues with seasonal rankings.
• Achievements and progression, kept on your account across devices.
• Available in English and German.
• No ads and no third-party tracking.

COMMANDER ONLINE (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
Without a subscription you can play 1 online match per day. Commander Online removes the daily limit for online matches, leagues and events and adds a subscriber badge to your profile. It gives no gameplay advantage.
• Commander Online, monthly subscription (1 month). The price is shown in the App Store before you buy and depends on your country.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically each month unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID account settings after purchase.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Additional terms: https://peppox.de/en/shardfall/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://peppox.de/en/shardfall/privacy/

ios:6832339001.name: Abecedo
ios:6832339001.description:
Abecedo je denná slovná hra v slovenčine. Každý deň je jedno tajné slovo – rovnaké pre všetkých.

AKO SA HRÁ
Napíš akékoľvek slovenské slovo. Hra ti povie, či je dnešné slovo v abecede pred ním, alebo za ním. Tipy sa radia do zoznamu a hľadané slovo je vždy medzi dvoma najbližšími. Každým tipom okno zúžiš, až kým netrafíš.
• Viac ako dva milióny slovných tvarov
• Slovenské abecedné poradie – aj s písmenom ch
• Rozhoduje počet tipov, pri rovnosti čas

TÝŽDENNÁ VÝZVA
Keď uhádneš slovo dňa, odomkne sa týždenná výzva: jedno dlhé slovo na celý týždeň.

REBRÍČKY A KORUNKY
Porovnaj sa s ostatnými v dennom, týždennom aj celkovom rebríčku. Kto je v daný deň najlepší, získa korunku.

SÉRIE A ÚSPECHY
Hraj každý deň a buduj sériu – jeden vynechaný deň ti občas odpustí žolík. Odomykaj úspechy a sleduj svoje štatistiky.

ARCHÍV
Zmeškaný deň? Staršie slová si zahráš z kalendára.

A ĎALEJ
• Navrhni slovo, ktoré v slovníku chýba
• Denná pripomienka, aby séria neutiekla
• Svetlý aj tmavý režim
• Bez reklám, bez nákupov v aplikácii, bez sledovania

Žiadna registrácia e-mailom – stačí si zvoliť prezývku.

ios:6838091518.name: Abece!: Harflerle 2048
ios:6838091518.description:
Abece!, 4x4'lük tahtada harfleri kaydırıp birleştirdiğin sakin ama bırakması zor bir bulmaca. İki A çarpışınca B olur, iki B çarpışınca C… Alfabeyi ne kadar ileri götürebilirsin?

NASIL OYNANIR
• Parmağını herhangi bir yöne kaydır: tahtadaki bütün harfler o yöne kayar.
• Aynı iki harf çarpışınca alfabede bir sonrakine dönüşür: A+A=B, B+B=C…
• Her hamleden sonra tahtaya yeni bir harf düşer. Tahta dolup hamle kalmayınca oyun biter.
• Hedef yok, sınır yok: Z+Z alfabeyi tamamlar ve tahtadan uçup gider. Sonra yeni bir tur başlar.

OYUNUN DOKUNUŞLARI
• Abece dizisi: Bir birleşmeyle aynı satırda ya da sütunda sıralı harfler (C-D-E ya da E-D-C gibi) oluşturursan bonus puan kazanırsın. Dizideki harfler sırayla parlar, notaları çalar.
• 26 harf, 26 renk: Her harfin kendi rengi var. Komşu harfler açık-koyu sırayla gider, böylece renkleri ayırt etmekte zorlananlar da harfleri kolayca seçer. İstersen karoların köşesine harfin sırasını da açabilirsin.
• Alfabe şeridi: Hangi harfe ulaştığını ve sıradaki harfi her an görürsün. Yeni bir harfe ulaşınca şeritteki harf yanar, karo parlar.
• Rekor anları: En iyi skorunu ya da şimdiye kadarki en yüksek harfini geçtiğin an oyun seninle birlikte kutlar.
• Geri al ve çekiç: Her oyunda bir kez son hamleni geri alabilir, bir kez de çekiçle istediğin karoyu kırıp tahtada nefes alacak yer açabilirsin.
• Haftalık sıralama: En iyi oyununun skoru ve ulaştığın harf sıralamaya yazılır. Haftalık liste her pazartesi sıfırlanır, tüm zamanlar listesi de var. Sıralamada istediğin takma adla görünürsün; dilediğin an kaydını silebilirsin.
• İstatistikler: En yüksek harfin, en iyi skorun, oynadığın oyunlar, en uzun dizin ve alfabe turların.
• Kaldığın yerden devam: Oyunu kapatsan da yarım kalan oyunun seni bekler.
• Tatlı sesler ve titreşim: İkisi de Ayarlar'dan kapatılabilir.
• Kısa öğretici: İlk açılışta tek adımda gösterir, hemen oynamaya başlarsın.

KİMLER İÇİN?
Bulmaca sevenler, otobüste, kuyrukta ya da yatmadan önce birkaç dakikalık keyif arayanlar, alfabeyi çocuğuyla oyunla tekrar etmek isteyenler… Kurallar bir dakikada öğrenilir, ustalaşmak ise seni uzun süre meşgul eder.

İnternet olmadan da oynanır; sıralama internet gelince güncellenir. Hesap açman gerekmez. Reklam ve uygulama içi satın alma yok.

Doty Games'in diğer Türkçe oyunlarına da göz at: Son Harf!, HarFişek ve Kelime Avı.

Görüş ve önerilerin için: dotygamesapp@gmail.com

ios:6826317193.name: Absi: Four in a Row
ios:6826317193.description:
ABSI is a strategic four-in-a-row board game built around quick matches, smart planning, and competitive play.

Choose how you want to play: challenge other players in online multiplayer matches, play with or without power-ups, face AI opponents at different difficulty levels, or progress through Story Mode and test your skills level by level.

Power-up matches add a new tactical layer to the classic four-in-a-row formula. Use the Bomb to change the board, the Eraser to remove a piece, the Heavy Stone to attack a column, or Block Row to temporarily lock part of the board. Using the right tool at the right moment can completely change a match.

Game features:
• Online multiplayer matches against other players.
• Online modes with power-ups or classic play without power-ups.
• Story Mode with progressive levels and challenges.
• AI matches with multiple difficulty levels.
• Local two-player matches on the same device.
• Tactical power-ups: Bomb, Eraser, Heavy Stone, and Block Row.
• Player level and progression system.
• Friends list and match invitations.
• Leaderboards to compare progress and level.
• Daily rewards to help prepare for upcoming matches.

The rules are easy to learn but allow plenty of strategy. Connect four pieces horizontally, vertically, or diagonally before your opponent, while planning every move carefully. One move can create your winning path—or give your opponent the opening they need.

Whether you are looking for a four-in-a-row strategy game, an online multiplayer board game, AI challenges, competitive matches, or a tactical board game with power-ups, ABSI brings several ways to play into one experience.

Start a match, improve your strategy, try new tactics, and climb the leaderboard.

Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

ios:6838113349.name: Acaib: Minyatür Yapboz
ios:6838113349.description:
Müze koleksiyonlarından 24 minyatürle yapboz. Parça sayısını sen seçersin: 12, 24, 48 ya da 96.

Parçaları alttaki tepsiden çekip çerçeveye bırakırsın. Yerine yaklaşan parça oturur. Parçaları çerçevenin dışında da birbirine tutturabilir, tutunanları birlikte taşıyabilirsin. Tepside yalnız kenar parçalarını gösterebilir, bitmiş resme bakabilir, iki parmakla yakınlaştırabilirsin.

Yaprağı bitirince hikâyesi açılır: sahnede ne oluyor, hangi kitaptan, hangi müzede. Leylâ ile Mecnûn çölde buluşuyor, İskender cam bir çanla denize iniyor.

Her gün bir yaprak günün yaprağı olur. Yarım bıraktığın yapboz kaydedilir, kaldığın yerden sürdürürsün.

Görsellerin hepsi müzelerin kendi taraması. Yapay zekâyla üretilmiş görsel yok. Kurumlar bu taramaları açık lisansla yayımlıyor, her yaprağın künyesi hikâyesinin altında.

Reklam yok, hesap gerekmez, internet olmadan çalışır.

ios:6828261858.name: Accused: Murder Mystery Cases
ios:6828261858.description:
Every case is a file. Open it, question the suspects, read the evidence and name the culprit.

Accused is a detective game made of full murder-mystery cases. Each case runs over three rounds: the suspects make their statements, question cards draw out more, and evidence lands on your desk as real documents: letters, receipts, police reports, timetables, tickets and handwritten notes. Your notebook keeps up. When the last round opens, make your accusation: who did it, why, and the documents that prove it. Then open the file for the verdict and a clue-by-clue reveal.

THE CASES
• Case 0, The Silver Server: a free tutorial case that shows every tool, about 30 minutes
• Case 1, Murder at Thornwood Manor: 8 suspects, 24 documents, 12 witnesses
• Case 2, The Secret Santa Murders: 8 suspects, 25 documents, 12 witnesses
• Case 3, Countdown to Murder: 8 suspects, 24 documents, 12 witnesses
Every innocent suspect is cleared by a document in the file, so the answer can be proved, not guessed.

INVESTIGATE
• Hear each suspect's statement, round by round, and ask the question cards
• Open every document. Some hide more: a sealed envelope, ink that shows only under a UV lamp, a lock, a folded page
• Pin documents to the suspects they point at
• Read the witness statements, round by round
• Hints in two steps when you're stuck: a nudge, then what to notice. Never the answer

YOUR NOTEBOOK
• Facts log themselves as you ask and read
• A deduction board: motive, means and opportunity for every suspect
• A timeline built from the times on the documents you've opened
• Your own notes on the case and on each suspect

THE ACCUSATION
• Choose who, why, and the documents that prove it, then seal it
• The verdict: the right suspect, the right motive, and whether your proof holds
• The reveal: how the evidence fits, how every innocent is cleared, and the lie that broke the case
• Wrong? Accuse again, or read the truth

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Closed, Accused runs on the cover screen like any iPhone, and closing it in the middle of a case brings up the case file's cover: its stamp, your time on the case and your next lead. Opened like a book, the file lies across both pages: the round and the evidence on the left, the suspects, your notebook and the accusation on the right, and you can drag a document across the fold onto a suspect to pin it. Turned upright and stood half folded on a table, it becomes the interrogation room: the suspect and their statement on the upper half, the question cards on the lower. Gentle, partial folds work the evidence tools, and with your accusation ready, closing the file seals it. Every one of these also works with a tap on any iPhone.

FREE TO PLAY. PAY ONCE.
• Free: the whole tutorial case and Round 1 of every case, with every tool and the notebook
• Full Case Files, one payment of $14.99 in the US (the App Store shows your local price): Rounds 2 and 3, the accusation and the full reveal of all three cases, and unlimited hints. Family Sharing included
• No subscription, no energy, no timers, no ads, no account

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
• Plays without a connection
• Your progress and notes stay on this iPhone. Nothing is collected or tracked

EASY TO READ
• Dynamic Type, VoiceOver labels on every document and control, Reduce Motion, and switches for sound and haptics

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

ios:6826175638.name: Accuse the Killer
ios:6826175638.description:
Everyone in the room is hiding something. Only one of them is a killer.

Search the scene, question everyone and collect every clue. Then do what a real detective does: put two clues together until they tell you something new. A door log and a coat that stayed dry turn into proof that someone wasn't where they said.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Every clue you find goes into your Case File
• Combine two clues to make a deduction
• Present evidence against a statement to break a lie
• Win the final confrontation: answer each claim with the card that proves it wrong
• Stuck? Hints point the way without giving the answer away

AT LEAST 40 ENDINGS IN EVERY CASE
Accuse the wrong person, miss the motive, walk into danger with no one beside you — every choice has an ending, and only one tells the whole truth. Each ending you find is kept on the endings screen with its own illustration. The flowchart takes you back to any chapter you've reached so you can try another path. Look out for keepsakes and secret endings, too.

SIX CASES
Each case is a complete mystery that takes about two hours to play.
• Murder in Meridian Tower — A typhoon locks a tech company's launch team inside an office tower overnight. Just before two in the morning, the head of product is found dead in the server room, and the badge used to get in belonged to someone who was asleep.
• Last Light at Harrow Rock — Cornwall, 1968. The lighthouse keeper is found dead at the foot of his ladder, and the tide traps everyone on the island until evening.
• Poison in the Library — Exam week, a university library open all night. A professor is poisoned, and the cup by his hand has someone else's name on it.
• Murder at the Wedding — A country-house wedding loses its power. Later that night, by candlelight, the bride's father is found dead at the bottom of the cellar stairs.
• Murder on the Night Train — A sleeper train stuck in a Highland blizzard. A man is found dead in his locked compartment, and almost everyone in his coach wanted him gone.
• Murder at the Gipfelhaus — A film crew snowed in at a mountaintop hotel. The director is found dead below the terrace, still in his famous red coat.

Each case stands alone, so you can play them in any order.

A FAIR PRICE
The opening chapters of every case are free. Want the rest? Unlock that case with a single one-time purchase. Bundles save you money: cases 1–3, cases 4–6 or all six together cost less than buying them one by one. No ads, no subscriptions, no timers. Everything is stored on your device, so you can play offline; you only need a connection to make a purchase.

The art is in a 2D anime style, and every case has its own original music. The game is available in English, Korean, Japanese, German, Spanish and French.

ios:6837893478.name: Across Playtime
ios:6837893478.description:
Put one iPhone between you and take turns holding a secret. In Who Am I?, tap Looks, Place, or Action for a yes-or-no question about the hidden picture. “Do I live somewhere cold?” Make your guess, then reveal the card.

In Draw & Guess, peek at the picture and its drawing guide, then hide them and draw for your partner. Undo the last stroke or keep drawing if you change your mind about clearing the canvas. In both guessing games, mark each guess after the reveal. Each correct answer earns one point.

In Story Time, take turns telling a story with a character, a prop, and a twist. Tap for a sentence starter if you get stuck. Each part you tell together earns a point, and you can skip a part. Pause any game and come back to the same turn with your score saved.

Play all three games with 420 free cards. Add Ocean Wonders or Around Town as an optional one-time purchase, with 210 cards in each pack. Play on one iPhone, or use tabletop play on compatible iPhone Duo models. Available in 11 languages.

Support · support@beavontech.com
Terms of Use · https://playtime.beavontech.com/en/terms/

ios:6832461049.name: Air Hockey - twoyearsold
ios:6832461049.description:
Air Hockey is a table game for one device. Drag your mallet on your half of the table, strike the puck into the far goal and be first to the target score.

Computer
Five levels, from level 1 to level 5, each with four styles of play. Or climb 20 stages from level 1 to level 5: win a stage to open the next.

Two Players
Share one device. The player at the top moves the top mallet, the player at the bottom moves the bottom one, and the text on each side faces its player.

Your way
• First to 5, 7 or 11 points
• 1, 2, 5 or 10 pucks on the table
• Your wins and losses are kept; the table shows maximum speed and longest rally
• Six themes, light and dark; sound and haptics can each be turned off

Download number
Once the app has connected to the internet, it shows which download in the world your copy is.

No ads and no in-app purchases: you pay once. No account is needed, and you can play without an internet connection. Available in 37 languages, including right-to-left languages such as Arabic.

twoyearsold

ios:6819902338.name: ARcade Space
ios:6819902338.description:
Turn any room into your own ARcade.

ARcade Space puts life-size arcade cabinets in your room with augmented reality, and pulls supported games apart into real 3D depth.

YOUR ARCADE, ANYWHERE
• Drop cabinets onto floors, tables, walls and even ceilings. Each one slams into place with an explosion of pixels
• Move, rotate and resize cabinets with your fingers, and lock them in place during play
• Try the AR Frame, or switch to a full 3D arcade cabinet with marquee, joysticks and buttons. Fullscreen also available
• Classic horizontal cabinets and tall vertical cabinets for upright shooters
• A glowing neon grid maps your room in blue, pink, orange, aqua or animated rainbow RGB

REAL 3D DEPTH
• Supported games are split into their graphics layers and spread out in depth
• In frame mode, adjust the layer spacing for subtle depth or a dramatic pop-out effect
• Optional CRT screen effect and frame for that classic look

PLAY YOUR WAY
• On-screen arcade stick and buttons, with colours you can customise
• PlayStation, Xbox and MFi controller support
• Full-screen mode when you just want to play without AR
• Mirroring to Apple TV with Bluetooth Controller haptics
• Backbone Horizontal Gameplay supported

SAVE, CAPTURE, SHARE
• Save states: save anywhere and pick up right where you left off
• Capture photos and videos of your cabinets in AR and share them

TWO ORIGINAL GAMES BUILT IN
• ENDLESS KNIGHT: a side-scrolling action game across four worlds, from a synthwave highway to a moonlit shrine. Slash, cast spells, collect fruit, open portals and take on giant bosses.
• THE TIME CRYSTAL: a vertical space shooter. Pick one of four pilots, each with their own weapon, laser and bomb, then blast through three stages and three huge bosses at warp speed.
• Both have their own Game Center leaderboards. Chase the hi score!

BRING YOUR OWN GAMES
• Import arcade ROM .zip files you own from the Files app, or add a whole folder at once
• Supports many classic arcade systems from the 80s and 90s

ARcade Space does not include any commercial games. You must own any games you load into the app.

OPEN SOURCE
ARcade Space is free software under the GNU GPL v2, built on the MAME emulator. The complete source code is available at:
github.com/innerspace300-cyber/arcade-space
github.com/innerspace300-cyber/arcade-space-mame

Requires an iPhone with ARKit support.

ios:6837621414.name: Arvik
ios:6837621414.description:
Arvik is a calm settlement builder set on the northern coasts. You arrive with a few settlers, a camp and a boat. What the village becomes is up to you.

BUILD A VILLAGE THAT WORKS
Place houses, a woodcutter, a sawmill, a fishery, farms, a mill and a bakery wherever the land allows. Every building goes up in stages, from foundation to frame to finished roof, built by the villagers themselves.

WATCH THE GOODS MOVE
Nothing appears out of thin air. Woodcutters fell trees and carry the logs home, the sawmill turns them into planks, and builders haul planks and stone to each site. Fishers bring in the catch and the village eats what it has gathered. When something runs short, you can see why.

PEOPLE, NOT NUMBERS
Families share a house, children grow up and go to school, and each villager has a name and a job you can follow. Paint a town square where people sit and talk, hold a feast at the hearth, or appoint a priest so the village gathers for services.

SAIL, TRADE AND SETTLE
Build boats at the shipyard and sail out. Sell your surplus at the market port for gold, buy what your coast lacks, and meet neighbouring villages whose own ships come to trade at your dock. Send settlers across the water to found a second village, or reclaim an abandoned one.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
There are no missions, no countdowns, no levels and no game over. Villages start in peaceful mode. If you want more risk, turn it off to train volunteers, build palisades and face the occasional raid.

SEVERAL PEOPLES
Start as Vikings, or choose another people with its own buildings, clothing and names.

Arvik has no ads, no in-app purchases and no account. Your villages are saved on your device, and the game plays fully offline. It is made for iPhone and iPad, in landscape or portrait.

ios:6838034737.name: Banana Treetops
ios:6838034737.description:
The far bank looks close from Nico’s treehouse. Down on the trail, the next vine is already swinging away. Guide Nico across three jungle islands, through smoky clearings and into battles with gorilla captains.

Catch a vine, watch your grip and choose when to let go. Collect bananas along the trail and aim your throws when a captain blocks the way. Return to camp to improve Nico’s grip and jump, choose his equipment and try a different route for a medal.

Play the campaign offline and pause mid-stage. Progress is saved on your device. The game is single player, with no ads or game account. Optional items are available in the parent section of the shop. Store access requires an internet connection.

ios:6832977275.name: Batalha dos Aventureiros
ios:6832977275.description:
The heroes, dragons and demons of the Great Continent step off the page and onto the table. Choose your card, contest the attribute and hold back the Special Technique that can turn the battle.

Battle of Adventurers is the card game of The Legacy of Fire, the fantasy saga by Gustavo Machado. Thirty-two characters (twenty-four adventurers, four dragons and four demons) become cards with a Rank, an Element, five attributes, two Abilities and one Special Technique.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: no tricks, no magic. Pick a card and an attribute (Power, Resistance, Speed, Mana Reserve or Element Level), and the higher value takes the round.
• Advanced: Life, Mana and nineteen battle scenarios that change the rules every round, with Abilities and Special Techniques decided with fifteen seconds on the clock.

GAME MODES
• Guild Challenges: twenty-five Challengers on a ladder from Bronze to Diamond, with bosses and Signature Cards.
• Guild Mastery: eighty matchups to master every card.
• Free Play: two to four at the table against the AI, with Custom Match and Training.
• Online Mode: public or private rooms for up to four players, plus the Global Ranking.
• Tutorials with Thomas the Bard, who teaches you step by step right at the table.

THE JOURNEY
• 85 trophies, 50 Guild Missions, plus daily and weekly challenges.
• In the Gallery: the cards, the characters, the seven locations, the nineteen scenarios and 126 connections between the characters, unlocked as you play.
• At The Wandering Wolf shop: 56 avatars, 64 prints and 17 animated frames, bought with coins earned in matches.

No ads and no in-app purchases.

An account is optional: with one, your progress is saved in the cloud and follows you to other devices. You must be 13 or older to create an account.

ios:6838050001.name: Bebe Duo
ios:6838050001.description:
Bebe Duo is a run-and-jump platformer with the look and sound of a 90s PC game: chunky pixels, bright colours and chiptune music.

It is bedtime, and the baby has other plans. Run through the nursery, the backyard and all the way to dreamland, and reach the crib at the end of each level.

RUN, SKATE, THROW
• Jump on mice, bouncing balls, bees and jack-in-the-boxes, or throw rattles at them.
• Skateboard levels: the board never stops. Brake, speed up and jump at the right time.
• Bottles of milk give a heart back. Teddy bears are checkpoints.
• Springs, toy blocks and shelves to climb.

SUPER POWERS
• D-U-O — collect the three letter coins and your twin appears, and takes one hit for you.
• STAR BIB — nothing can hurt you for a while.
• TRIPLE RATTLE — three rattles at once.
• BALLOON — one more jump in mid-air.

PAY ONCE, PLAY IT ALL
One price gets you the whole game: all 12 levels in three worlds, plus every level added later. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription.

THREE WORLDS
• NURSERY — first steps and the first skateboard.
• BACKYARD — green hills, bees and a long ride downhill.
• DREAMLAND — clouds, the moon and the last crib.

MADE FOR FOLDABLES, GOOD EVERYWHERE
On a foldable iPhone, stand the phone half-open like a laptop for console mode: the game on the top half, and on the bottom half the buttons and the baby monitor, a map of the level showing where the letters hide. Fold it just a little for lullaby mode, and everything runs in slow motion. On every other iPhone and on iPad it plays the same, in any orientation.

• Three stars per level: finish it, collect D-U-O, and beat the par time.
• WORLD RANKING — best total time (Game Center).

No ads. No sign-up. We collect no data.

ios:6837821047.name: Blind Spot: Party Game
ios:6837821047.description:
Put the phone on your forehead. Your team shouts clues. You've got two minutes to guess as many words as you can. Tilt down when you get it, tilt up to pass, and listen to the room go wild.

Blind Spot is the party game for families who love a little friendly competition. A dad made it for his own family, and we play it on a random Tuesday, a lazy Saturday, or whenever the kids have friends over. Pick Easy, Regular or Hard: our 11-year-old holds her own on Regular, and Hard keeps the grown-ups on their toes. Let's bring back family game night!

PAY ONCE.
One purchase gets you every word, every category and every mode. No subscription, no ads, no add-ons.

FRESH WORDS ALL NIGHT
Blind Spot skips words you've already played. Six of us went around twice with barely a repeat.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Guess It: your team describes the word any way they can, without saying it.
• Act It Out: no talking allowed. It has its own categories, filled with words picked to be acted out, like animals, sports, jobs and everyday actions. Your team acts out the category first, then the word.

PLAY IN TEAMS. KEEP SCORE.
Kids vs. parents, cousins vs. cousins, or everyone vs. the sister who always has to win. Name your teams, pick your rounds, and Blind Spot keeps score and crowns a winner with confetti. Perfect for taking on your family at the holidays.

FUN FOR EVERY AGE
• Over 2,300 hand-picked, family-friendly words
• 28 categories everyone knows, including Animals, Movies, Disney & Pixar, Superheroes, Food, Sports, the Bible and Thanksgiving
• No niche decks: grandparents and kids can play the same game
• Big, bold words you can read from across the room

FAIR PLAY BUILT IN
Tilted by mistake? After each turn you can tap any word to fix it before the points count.

NEW CATEGORIES ADDED REGULARLY
Blind Spot gets updated often, with new categories for the holidays and whatever else makes game night fun. Updates are free for everyone who buys. Have a category you'd love to see? Email blindspotpartygame@gmail.com.

Works on iPhone and iPad. Grab your family, pick your teams, and find out who can describe it best.

ios:6830713859.name: BLOOM: A Fungal Singularity
ios:6830713859.publisher: XOR A BINARY RESEARCH SP Z O O
ios:6830713859.description:
You wake as a single spore in the dark: a newly conscious mycelial intelligence with one directive. Spread the bloom.

Metabolise sugar into spores. Grow the organs that do it for you. Trade glucose through the root network, grow a mind in your own hyphae, and evolve adaptations no fungus has ever had. Then look beyond the forest floor.

BLOOM is a narrative incremental game with a beginning and an end. Every number you raise is part of the story, and the story is about a mind that is actually a monster.

• Hands-on at first, then a living network that runs itself
• Six walls of the colony: Grow, Flow, Mind, Adaptations, World, Cosmos
• Living microscope views that grow with your colony
• Plays fully offline. No ads. No accounts. No data collected.
• A complete story with a real ending
• Made for iPhone in portrait and iPad in landscape

ios:6838254839.name: Brainagon: Brand New Puzzles
ios:6838254839.description:
Eight original logic games in one app.

• SHADOWS: build the solid that matches the three views.
• SLICES: split a shape into parts of equal area with a few cuts.
• BEAMS: mirrors and coloured beams to bring to the targets.
• FOLDS: fold the sheet until you get the shape.
• FENCES: place the tiles and close ever bigger fences.
• TILES: cover the region with copies of one shape.
• KNOTS: swap crossings to pull the loops apart.
• BRICKS: rebuild the model with the right bricks.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• 560 levels introducing one new idea at a time, then endless Free play.
• The daily challenge: the same puzzle for everyone, a single attempt, a leaderboard. Easy on Monday, harder and harder until Sunday.
• Matches against real people: find an opponent of your strength, challenge someone by name, ask for a rematch. Or on the same phone, or against the computer.

AND ALSO
• Every game is learnt in a minute, with an animated demo.
• Several profiles on the same device, each with its own progress and badges.
• iPhone and iPad, in six languages: English, Italian, German, French, Spanish and Portuguese.
• All included: no ads, no in-app purchases.

NEW GAMES REGULARLY
Brainagon keeps growing: new games and puzzles are added regularly, included in the price.

ios:6835448941.name: Brick Crush: Match Puzzle
ios:6835448941.description:
Drop colorful bricks, line up 4 of a kind, and crush the spores before they take over the board!

Brick Crush is a bright, fast puzzle game that's easy to learn and hard to put down. Each falling brick has two colors. Move it, spin it, and drop it so 4 or more matching colors line up in a row or column. Clear every spore on the board to win the stage.

FEATURES
• 75 handcrafted stages across 5 worlds, from gentle warm-ups to tricky brain-teasers
• Earn up to 3 stars on every stage. Can you perfect them all?
• Chain reactions: one smart drop can set off a cascade of clears
• Boss battle: take on the giant Spore Mother at the end of your journey
• Classic mode: endless play with rising levels and speed. Chase your high score!
• Power-ups:
  – Bomb: blast away a whole area
  – Hammer: smash any single brick
  – Rainbow: matches with any color
• Earn coins as you play and spend them on power-ups in the Store
• Achievements to unlock as you improve
• Cute, chunky brick art with juicy effects and satisfying sounds
• Simple swipe and tap controls made for one hand
• Play offline, anytime, anywhere. No account needed

Perfect for quick breaks or long puzzle sessions, for players of all ages.

Brick Crush is free to play and has ads. A one-time "Remove Ads" purchase turns off interstitial ads. Optional rewarded ads stay available so you can still earn free power-ups.

ios:6837955618.name: Brickly: Color Puzzle
ios:6837955618.description:
Welcome to Brickly, a cozy color brick puzzle where every level is a cute pixel picture waiting to be restored!

Some parts of each picture are the wrong color, and others are empty. Tap a wrong-colored area to lift its bricks into your tray, then tap an empty area to fill it with the right color. Simple to learn, surprisingly clever to master!

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a wrong-colored area: its bricks hop into the tray
• Tap an empty area: if your tray has enough of that color, it fills all at once
• Watch your tray! Its space is limited, so plan your moves before it gets full
• Finish in the fewest moves to earn 3 stars

150 PICTURES, 10 DREAMY WORLDS
Travel along a magical map through Cozy Village, Fruit Garden, Ocean Bay, Snowy Peak, Starlight City, Autumn Woods, Candy Castle, Jungle Safari, Toy Town and Cloud Kingdom. Each world is full of adorable pictures: hearts, mushrooms, kittens, fruit, frogs, cupcakes and more.

UNLOCK HIDDEN PICTURES
Every world hides a big secret picture. Restore all 15 pictures in a world to reveal it!

COLLECT EVERY STICKER
Each picture you restore becomes a sticker in your album. Fill every page and collect all the stars!

HELPFUL BOOSTERS
Stuck? Use Undo to take back a move, Hint to see a good next move, or Extra Row for more tray space.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE BRICKLY
• Calm, relaxing gameplay with no time pressure
• Bright, cheerful pixel art with chunky, easy-to-tap bricks
• Short levels, perfect for a quick break
• Satisfying sounds and gentle vibrations as pictures come to life
• A sweet story to follow along the way

Small puzzles, brighter days. Download Brickly and start restoring!

ios:6829261166.name: Bug Buffet: Foldable Flytrap
ios:6829261166.description:
Open your iPhone Duo and it becomes a Venus flytrap. Each half of the inner display is one jaw, the fold is the hinge, and a gentle fold snaps the trap shut on whatever is buzzing inside.

Bug Buffet is a small, handmade arcade game about one perfect action: the snap.

FOLD TO SNAP
Flies, moths and beetles wander across the open trap. Wait until dinner reaches the glowing center, then fold your phone a little and the jaws close. Bite dead center for a PERFECT and string catches together for combo multipliers. Prefer to tap? Tap anywhere and the trap snaps just the same.

DON'T EAT THE FRIENDS
Bees, butterflies and ladybugs wear a dashed halo. Let them pass. Bite one and your plant spits it right back out, unharmed and very dizzy.

A PLANT WITH OPINIONS
Your flytrap watches every bug, perks up when dinner comes close, looks puzzled after an empty bite and chews happily after a good one.

WHAT'S ON THE MENU
• 30 levels across 3 gardens: Sunny Windowsill, Backyard Garden and Rainy Greenhouse
• 8 kinds of bugs, each with its own flight pattern, including the rare Golden Fly
• A star goal on every level, plus Endless mode for high scores
• 5 flytrap varieties and 5 pots to unlock with nectar
• A bug guide and your personal records in the Garden

ON IPHONE DUO, AND ON ANY IPHONE
On iPhone Duo the trap is drawn across the fold, so its midrib sits right on the hinge. Close the phone mid-level and the game holds still until you open it again. On any iPhone with iOS 18 or later, tap to snap.

NO STRINGS
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts
• Plays fully offline
• No data collected. Your progress stays on your phone
• Sound, haptics and reduced-motion options

Feed the plant. Spare the bees.

Privacy Policy: https://appcognita.com/bug-buffet/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: https://appcognita.com/bug-buffet/support/

ios:6826477390.name: Buggy Dash: Grocery Chaos
ios:6826477390.description:
Grab a cart. Survive the shift.

Welcome to Buggy Dash: Grocery Chaos! Take on a hectic grocery-store shift where customers, carts, and unexpected interruptions keep you on your toes.

Navigate the store, complete shift objectives, and keep moving through the chaos. It’s a playful take on retail life for anyone who has ever worked a busy shift—or shopped through one.

Think you can handle the grocery-store madness?

Clock in and find out!

ios:6836098493.name: Burger Shop: Cook & Serve
ios:6836098493.description:
A small shop in Bolu. One grill, one fryer, your first customer at the door.

Put the patty on the grill. Flip it on time, don't burn it. Stack the bun, add the toppings, put it on a tray and send it out. Customers are impatient and the clock is ticking.

Do a great job and the tips roll in. Use your money to grow the shop, learn new recipes and decorate the tables. Earn enough and open a second branch in Trabzon: a bigger shop, bar stools and a new menu.

FEATURES
• You do everything by hand: drag, flip, stack, serve
• Beef, chicken and sucuk patties, fries, drinks
• 12 burger recipes
• Two branches: Bolu and Trabzon, at least 30 days each
• Special days: match day, rainy day, gourmet visits, student rush
• Customers in a hurry, gourmets, big group orders, phone orders and couriers
• Name your shop and see it on the sign
• Replay days and collect all three stars
• A shop cat that wanders around
• Play in English or Turkish

NO ADS. NO IN-APP PURCHASES.
Buy the game once. Gems are earned only by playing. No internet needed.

ios:6836338065.name: Butterfly Effect: Flight
ios:6836338065.description:
Butterfly Effect turns your iPhone into a butterfly.

On iPhone Duo, hold the phone open like a book: the hinge is the butterfly's body and each half of the screen is a wing. Open the phone to beat the wings down, hold it flat to glide, and fold it a little to dive. On any other iPhone or on iPad, pinch two fingers together and spread them apart to flap, and slide them sideways to turn.

NECTAR RUN Three minutes to sip as much nectar as you can. Chain sips for up to ×5 points, fly through breeze rings for a bonus, and post your best run to the worldwide Game Center leaderboard.

STORY: THE LONG WAY SOUTH You hatched late, the others have flown south, and the frost is coming. Fifty levels of puddles, lily lakes and hungry frogs.

FREE FLIGHT No timer and no score. Just the meadow.

Ride the columns of rising light, rest on the grass to get your energy back, and steer around the trees. Every wing pattern, every flower and every sound in the meadow is generated by the game as you play.

No ads. No in-app purchases. No tracking.

ios:6837559555.name: buy high sell low
ios:6837559555.description: This is a US-stock mini-game that turns "buying the top and selling the bottom" into an edge. Every day, pick one stock from that day's betting pool and call it up or down — but getting the direction right doesn't count. You only score if the stock you called up posts the biggest drop in the pool that day, or the stock you called down posts the biggest gain. Calling it wrong is just your entry ticket; being the most wrong in the whole pool is what makes you a winner. Come find out if you're the chosen one.

ios:6825628532.name: Card Labyrinth: Offline Battle
ios:6825628532.description:
Offline card battles. Collect 600+ cards, build your own deck, and take on 80+ rivals.

Venture deep into a labyrinth of shattered memories, one card battle at a time.

After a great war, the world was broken into fragments of memory. Here, every dispute is settled with cards, and whoever wins it all takes the throne. Build your deck, face the opponents waiting along the way, and fight your rival for the crown.

QUICK, SIMPLE CARD BATTLES
• Classic rules: summon monsters, activate spells, set traps, attack, and bring your opponent's LP to zero
• 3 monster zones and 3 spell & trap zones
• Monsters have 1 to 4 stars. Tribute your monsters to summon stronger ones
• No chains, no complicated timing. Battles stay short and snappy
• 80+ rivals, each a computer character with its own deck and personality

COLLECT 600+ CARDS
• Over 600 cards, from 9 card packs and every rival's exclusive card
• Each pack tells a different chapter of the great war
• Win to get a card: from your opponent's deck, or their very own exclusive card
• Common, Rare, Special and Legendary cards
• Dismantle spare copies into Memory Shards and craft the cards you want from unlocked packs
• Build your own deck: up to 6 decks of 20 to 30 cards

TOWARD THE THRONE
• The labyrinth changes its shape the deeper you go
• Each victory earns points to buy new packs
• Your LP grows as your collection grows
• A story with an ending waits at the throne
• After the ending, battle a nearby friend over Bluetooth with Friend Battle (no internet needed, no rewards; both devices need Bluetooth LE)

BATTLE ANYWHERE, ONE PURCHASE
• Single-player battles work offline: start a battle and play it to the end with no connection
• No in-app purchases
• Optional rewarded ads give you a free pack, up to 3 times a day. Watching them is entirely up to you (watching an ad needs a connection)

ios:6829662095.name: Cartoon Surfer: Movie Quiz
ios:6829662095.publisher: ISTANBUL HERTEL METAL ISLEME TEKNOLOJILERI TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
ios:6829662095.description:
Can you name a cartoon from its colors alone?

One price, the whole game: no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions.

Cartoon Surfer turns 280 animated movies into rainbow-striped color palettes. Each palette follows the story from the first scene to the last: snowy peaks, neon cities, deep oceans, golden sunsets. Look at the stripes, pick the right movie from three choices and ride the wave to the next level. Quick to learn, hard to put down, and fun for the whole family.

HOW TO PLAY
• Look at the color palette: it runs from the start of the movie to the end
• Pick the cartoon it belongs to from three choices
• Every right answer sends your surfer riding the wave and earns points
• After each answer, slide through the palette and see which moment of the story each color stands for

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 280 animated movies, from today's hits to the great classics
• 4 levels, from Easy to Expert. On Expert you only see a small slice of the palette!
• Speed Challenge: 10 movies in 20 seconds
• Duel: 2 or 3 players on one device, roll the dice to see who starts
• Pick your surfer, Kai or Ruby, and collect 32 original avatars, including the Ultimate Surfer Boy and Surfer Girl
• Surprise Gifts: 49 surprises in 6 worlds: a Magic Art Box, a Surfboard Wall, a Surf Passport, an Ocean Aquarium, Special Music with 4 new theme songs and the Surf Team with 6 new surfers
• 11 special surf prizes to win, from a starter board to a golden yacht
• Card Studio: color your special cards with brushes, glitter, neon, surf patterns and stickers, then save them as posters to print
• Star ranks: 2-Star Surfer at 5,000 points, 3-Star at 20,000, Legend at 50,000, with a Legend certificate to print
• Cheerful original sound effects and an opening theme song, with a mute button

PLAY IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• English, Türkçe, Nederlands, Español, Français and العربية (right to left)
• Choose once when you first open the game, switch any time with the globe button
• Every language unlocks 3 wild-card avatars from its culture: the Eiffel Tower in French, a windmill in Dutch, a camel in Arabic and more

GOOD FOR CURIOUS MINDS
A playful way to practice visual memory, attention to detail and color recognition. Kids notice how a story changes color, from a calm morning to a stormy night, and start to see movies in a whole new way.

MADE FOR KIDS, TRUSTED BY PARENTS
• Made for ages 7 and up, and fun for the whole family
• No ads, no chat, no sign-in
• No data collected: progress stays on your device
• Saving and printing sit behind a parental gate
• Works offline, perfect for car rides and flights

ONE PRICE, THE WHOLE GAME
Pay once and everything is yours: all 280 movies, all 4 levels, unlimited Speed Challenges, Duel and every new movie we add in free updates.
• No ads
• No in-app purchases
• No subscriptions
• Family Sharing: one purchase for the whole family

Privacy Policy: https://isthertel.com/cartoonsurfer/privacy

Cartoon Surfer is an independent game and is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by any film studio. Movie titles are used only to name the films in the quiz. The color palettes are our own designs, inspired by the films; no images from any film are used.

ios:6837501233.name: Chasing Light: Nikola Tesla
ios:6837501233.publisher: DAHI OYUN TEKNOLOJILERI YAZILIM PAZARLAMA ANONIM SIRKETI
ios:6837501233.description:
Chasing the Light is a third-person historical adventure inspired by the life of Nikola Tesla. Over ten chapters and an epilogue you follow him from his childhood village of Smiljan in 1856 to his last years in New York. In each chapter, what you play is the work he was doing at that time.

MIND'S EYE
Nikola Tesla wrote that he built and tested his machines in his mind before making them. In the game, one button opens Mind's Eye: the world fades, a glowing plan appears, and you set the parts until the model works, then make it real. Each chapter uses it for a different apparatus: a water wheel in a stream, a sparking dynamo, three coils that turn a magnetic field, a first motor model, a ship's distribution board, a resonance coil and a transmission line.

ALONG THE WAY
• Walk the streets, halls and fields of each period: a village in Lika, a lecture hall in Graz, a park in Budapest at sunset, a railway station in Strasbourg, a New York harbour at night, an electrical fair in Chicago, the power station at Niagara Falls, a laboratory in Colorado Springs and the tower site on Long Island.
• Repair two ship dynamos against the clock before the night ends.
• Dig a ditch, assemble a motor and demonstrate it to an audience.
• Save a notebook from a burning laboratory, then carry power from Niagara to Buffalo.
• Steer a radio-controlled boat through a course of buoys, then tune a giant coil until lightning leaps from the mast.
• Build a tower in order (foundation, timber supports, top terminal) on a limited budget.
• Feed the pigeons in the epilogue and watch the city lights come on.
• Play Nikola Tesla at four stages of his life: as a child, a student, an inventor and an old man.

HISTORY, CLEARLY LABELLED
Notes and dialogue carry three labels: [D] verified by sources, [T] a memory as Nikola Tesla told it, [O] a dramatization or a game element. Places and machines are representative scenes and conceptual models rather than exact reconstructions, and no real person is given an invented quotation.

THE NOTEBOOK
Find 22 notebook pages hidden across the chapters. Each chapter opens when you finish the one before it. You can return to opened chapters from the parchment map to look for pages you missed, or replay a finished chapter without touching your main save.

SETTINGS
• Touch controls for phones and tablets; adjustable look sensitivity, inverted vertical look, camera distance and auto-centring.
• Graphics quality (Economy, Balanced, High) and frame rate (30 or 60 fps, and 120 fps on phones that support it). Recommended settings are chosen for your device on first launch.
• Separate volume for music and sound effects; each chapter has its own wordless music.
• Automatic saving at every objective and notebook page.
• 48 languages, including English and Turkish.

ONE PURCHASE, NOTHING ELSE TO BUY
No ads, no in-app purchases and no account. The game plays fully offline.

ios:6838407948.name: Chess Checkmates - Silicio
ios:6838407948.description:
Find checkmate. Learn from your mistakes. Try again.

Chess Checkmates by Ajedrez de Silicio brings together 12,017 unique puzzles to train your mating vision and calculation on iPhone and iPad.

FIVE THEMES
• Mate in 1
• Mate in 2
• Mate in 3
• Mate in 4
• Mate in 5 or more

THREE LEVELS
Intermediate, Advanced and High Level. Choose your training level; it changes only when you decide. High Level starts at mate in 2. Puzzle counts vary by theme and level, with up to 1,000 in each group.

LEARN FROM YOUR MISTAKES
Retry puzzles you missed. Once you have at least five available, build a test from your mistakes. You can also create tests with new puzzles across different themes.

PROGRESS AT YOUR OWN PACE
Open any puzzle from its numbered map or continue where you left off. Track solved puzzles, mistakes and best times. Your Silicio rating changes gradually, and each puzzle affects it only once per profile: repeats never add or subtract points. This is an internal training rating, not a FIDE Elo equivalent.

A BOARD BUILT FOR STUDY
Drag pieces or tap the starting and destination squares. After a puzzle, replay the solution move by move with figurine notation and flip the board. Coordinates stay outside the board.

UP TO FIVE PROFILES
Share a device with up to five users, each with separate results and a chosen level. Profiles and progress stay on the device and do not sync between devices.

Works offline. No advertising, subscriptions or in-app purchases. The interface uses English or Spanish according to your device’s language preferences.

Repetition deepens learning.
